chunks.title: Session 2024-11-06: Improper Disposal (part 1) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-06: Improper Disposal (part 1) - summary
Back in Obsidius, the party shopped, consulted Willoughby Pindle about fungal samples from the Zuggtmoy cultists, and got dust masks, while Fezzle bought a pistol. Mangler recklessly ingested the samples with holy water, was briefly infected with the Spores of Zukt, and recovered at the Arcanist Guild. Spotless of the Expeditors Guild sent K'hakkik to investigate Garry Margos, who may have failed to dispose of thirteen bodies. The party staked out the Tombstone, learned of a hidden basement, and ended when Fezzle picked the front door lock and a gong sounded below.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-20: Improper Disposal (part 2) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-20: Improper Disposal (part 2) - summary
The party descended a hidden stair into a cavern workspace with magical circles, defeated a spider, and found Garry Margos's necromantic laboratory. They beat the Stitched-Together Creature, zombies, an Incomplete Golem and Garry himself, who was left unconscious but stable. They searched for bodies from Spotless's list, found a spellbook and sarcophagi, and chose to cover things up discreetly. Fezzle and Mangler later met Lorgo and Olga outside the Tombstone.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-03: Improper Disposal (part 3) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-03: Improper Disposal (part 3) - summary
Fezzle and Mangler negotiated with Lorgo and Olga at the Tombstone, leaving Garry in their custody in exchange for being allowed to handle the body disposal. With Olga's directions the party borrowed a wagon, took a fishing ship to Smudgekeep, bought horses and traveled overland toward Agarath. They defeated an ambush by Warped Creatures in the wasteland, then disposed of the bodies in the acid pools as a dragon flew overhead.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-07: Improper Disposal  (part 4) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-07: Improper Disposal  (part 4) - summary
The party dumped the bodies in the Agarath Acid Pools, saw a large dragon fly toward the sea, and met the orc mercenary Crunch at the Crater, who warned them about Dolgants and Dolgirms. In Smudgekeep they dealt with the wagon and horses, bought clockwork mounts, and Father Darmot Hammercog asked them to free a forge elemental from True Steel Hall. Having completed the Expeditors Guild job, they traveled back toward the Crater and were attacked by nightmarish insect-bat Horrors. The session ended mid-battle with the party frightened by the Horrors' screech.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-21: Obvious Forgery - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-21: Obvious Forgery - summary
The party overcame frightening creatures in the wasteland, then camped with exhausted travelers attacked by umber hulks. They escorted merchants carrying adamantine to Eogbore, where the Priest of Vulcan offered to sponsor Patch for Proving if the party restores and consecrates the ruined True Steel Forge. In the undercity they dug through rubble toward True Steel Hall and uncovered a nest of Kruthiks.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-04: Obvious Forgery (part 2) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-04: Obvious Forgery (part 2) - summary
The party killed a group of Kruthiks in an underground tunnel and found their bodies riddled with ballista bolts outside a portcullis. After detecting an ambush, they forced their way in and fought Duergar Warriors and a Hooded Duergar across several rooms, including invisible and enlarged foes. Skeletons and a Flaming Skeleton joined the fray, and Patch turned several undead. The fight in the Ballista Room was still unfinished at session end, with the party earning twenty percent toward their next level.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-18: Obvious Forgery (part 3) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-18: Obvious Forgery (part 3) - summary
The party fought the duergar at the forge complex entrance, using a ballista and Patch's Heat Metal to win. They searched the Forge Master's Quarters, learning how a demon posing as Vulcan doomed him, and took 675 gold in gems plus coins and trinkets from the duergar. They defeated frightened skeletons in a barricaded barracks, found Deep Lord Bloodhammer's orders, and sneaked past K'hakkik patrols. They ended by discovering six horrors performing a planar gate ritual in the feast hall, who noticed them and prepared to attack.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-04: Obvious Forgery (part 4) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-04: Obvious Forgery (part 4) - summary
The party fought dolgaunts, dolgrims and flying horrors in the throne room as a dark disc portal grew in the flames, while cruthics watched from the hallway. After the battle they found a webbed suspension bridge over a chasm, where Mangler got stuck in webbing and they spotted an invisible horse-sized spider with human-sized spider minions. They removed two tiers of the ladders, disarmed one trapped ballista, and gathered gems, pearls and powder kegs. They discussed ways to cross the bridge safely.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-18: Obvious Forgery (part 5) Fucking Webs - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-18: Obvious Forgery (part 5) Fucking Webs - summary
The party crossed a narrow, web-covered chasm bridge and fought phase spiders, during which K'hakkik was poisoned and paralyzed and then cured, and several spiders fell into the depths. They broke into a magical study in the True Steel Forge complex and dodged a fire-shooting wizard statue. They looted magical writings, crafting components and administrative records, but a poltergeist began hurling objects. The party ended caught between the spiders and the angry spirit.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-01: Obvious Forgery (part 6) Big_Room_Mo_Critters - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-01: Obvious Forgery (part 6) Big_Room_Mo_Critters - summary
The party explored an adamantine machine shop and collected construction plans, with Fezzle especially interested. They fought fused warped duergar in the courtyard, where K'hakkik repeatedly fell and was revived and Mynah's Web spells contained the Warped Seer and its winged leader. They fortified the machine shop and rested through a night of ghostly screams and a brief phase spider appearance. When Fezzle stepped out first, a tentacled horror seized him and left him suspended, poisoned and paralyzed as the session ended.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-15: Obvious Forgery (part 7) Fezzle Attempts Suicide - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-15: Obvious Forgery (part 7) Fezzle Attempts Suicide - summary
The party fought and killed an oversized Grell that had paralyzed Fezzle. They explored abandoned apartments, finding a burned map, then killed a mimic that stuck to Fezzle and found an adamantine-alloy dagger. They met four tiny fire elementals in a temple of Vulcan. In the forge chamber they fought duergar cultists and a Mutate Lord, freeing the forge elemental, which helped kill the Mutate Lord and then turned menacingly toward the party.

chunks.title: Session 2025-05-20: Obvious Forgery (part 8) Cleanup Begins - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-05-20: Obvious Forgery (part 8) Cleanup Begins - summary
The party met the Forge Elemental, which Mynah spoke with in Draconic, and it showed them the forge's damage and its wish for restoration. In the warehouse a chest turned out to be a mimic and the party killed it. They found the treasury's abandoned coins, took a long rest and reached level five. While exploring the living quarters they found letters about the Council of Three and adamantine items, then were ambushed by Durgrims and Durgaunts in the courtyard, and the fight was left unfinished.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-03: Obvious Forgery (part9) Bag and Tag - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-03: Obvious Forgery (part9) Bag and Tag - summary
The party finished off the Durgrims in the True Steel Forge complex, then explored the dormitories, apartments and leader's quarters. In the great hall they found three ghostly leaders on thrones and a hidden green planar seal with aberrations climbing the shaft below. They went to Smudgekeep to research and gather materials, returned and repaired the seal, though not to its original power. The forge was consecrated, Patch was proven in the Church of Vulcan, and the party received 10,000 gold and renown in Yogbor, ending at level 5.3.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-17: Little Ship of Horrors - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-17: Little Ship of Horrors - summary
The party traveled overland to Smudgekeep, shopped, and crossed the Ebon Sea back to Obsidius. There Mynah reported to Kroald Fortas, who explained the Daelkir and the many gatekeeper seals, and Fezzle sneaked into the Tombstone in disguise. Mangler and Patch sought a Spelljammer Guild proving and joined Captain Threx, hunting the pirate ship Wailing Star. They found the derelict Rising Star with its mind-shattered crew, then the Wailing Star attacked, wrecked the Plan C, and pulled the party aboard.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-01: Little Ship of Horrors--part 2 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-01: Little Ship of Horrors--part 2 - summary
Aboard the Wailing Star, the party found a room of fused helms and met Nimbrax, the ship's mind, along with its zombie crew. They trapped the zombies, lost a helm contest, and fought the helm mass before the Mangler won a truce. They agreed to take Nimbrax to the Mangler's abandoned citadel, Throm's Anvil, in the Gray Cluster, driving off scabbers on the way. Finding a vampirate galleon docked there, they hid the ship and landed on the asteroid.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-22: Little Ship of Horrors 3 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-22: Little Ship of Horrors 3 - summary
The party landed on the backside of Throm's Anvil, Mangler's abandoned former home, to avoid the vampirate galleon at the far docks. In the tunnels their stealth failed and they fought vampirates, shadows and a black pudding, destroying most of them while the vampirate mage teleported away. They confirmed the forge helm chamber's magic circle is still attuned to the pocket sun. Judging the vampirates to be exploring opportunistically, they flew back to their ship to consult Nimbrax about installing it.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-19: Little Ship of Horrors 4 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-19: Little Ship of Horrors 4 - summary
After the earlier vampirate clash, the party sailed Nimbrax's ship four miles from Throm's Anvil, took a long rest unseen, and planned a frontal assault on the vampirate galleon. When they returned, the galleon cast off and its captain turned the whole ship invisible. In the ship-to-ship fight Mangler was charmed by hypnotic pattern and Mynah's fireballs and Nimbrax's weapons destroyed several vampirates. Mangler, Fezzle, Patch and K'hakkik boarded the galleon, where Patch's light and Turn Undead broke the crew, and the session ended on the brink of a confrontation with the vampirate captain.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-02: Little Ship of Horrors 5 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-02: Little Ship of Horrors 5 - summary
The party won the battle aboard the vampirate galleon. Nimbrax's psychic wave, Patch's Turn Undead and Mynah's webs broke the crew, and Mangler killed the captain, while the vampire mage escaped by Dimension Door. Fezzle attuned to the galleon's helm and revived the Fez, and the search turned up jewelry, a javelin of lightning and a logbook showing the vampirates hunt privateers opposing a cult. After a long rest, the party docked at Throm's Anvil's tower and cleared a vampirate ambush in its storage area, with more levels still to explore.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-16: Back to Obsidius - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-16: Back to Obsidius - summary
The party finished off the vampirates in the Throm's Anvil docking tower, and The Mangler installed Nimbrax at the pocket sun circle, empowering it. Nimbrax restored the Wailing Star crew, and the party rescued Threx and the Rising Star crew after negotiating over helm ownership. Nimbrax moved the asteroid back to Obsidius, where The Mangler was proven in the Spelljammers Guild. K'hakkik's foster parents identified the obsidian coins as Cult of the Dragon markers, and guild inquiries showed the vampirates hunted privateers contracted to oppose the cult.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-30: Business Lunch - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-30: Business Lunch - summary
The party kept Nimbrax and Throm's Anvil airborne, sold the Midnight Cry treasure after Fezzle suffered a traumatic flashback at the war mask, and set up bastion facilities. They lunched with Merchant Guild Chairman Sansbury, who admitted hiring the privateers and offered gold or a favor, and the party kept the favor. They then hunted Myca through the low market, curing Carl, scouting the beggar's kitchen and Griffin House, and finding a hidden basement. Following a wagon of the sick led them to a disused fish processing building holding a large fungus creature.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-14: The Raid - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-14: The Raid - summary
The party investigated a Blackwind Shipping warehouse in the Obsidius dock district where a wagon had taken a sick person, and decided on a direct assault. Shriekers sounded an alarm, and The Mangler broke down the door, revealing cultists and fungal creatures. Combat followed with spore clouds, Mynah's fireball, and K'hakkik's hallucinations cured by Patch. The corrupted Myca emerged commanding shambling mounds and an awakened zurkwood, and the party was bloodied but holding at the end.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-28: Mica's End (?) - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-28: Mica's End (?) - summary
The party finished the warehouse battle, with Mynah's fireball destroying the Zurkwood and Fezzle cutting free from a shambling mound. Myca died and his final spell released necrotic spores that killed bystanders and collapsed the warehouse, but the party found spore-laden fish crates and escaped with a captive scholar, Freylin. Freylin claimed the cult's patron is really the Daelkyr Avash, and the party identified the Hand of Avash and Marvelous Pigments from Myca's briefcase. Spotless then offered Chairman Sansbury's dragon cultist bounty, leaving the party to choose between it and the Great Grove Below.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-11: Meet the Family! - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-11: Meet the Family! - summary
The party pursued the Cult of the Dragon via Rail Guild contacts Sunny Stone and Sister Gladys, then learned from Master Grynd that hobgoblin-led raiders had robbed the Greenway towns. After Fezzle's family summoned him home, they found Alderdale badly damaged and accepted Mayor Gronzel's contract to stop the raiders. They tracked the Starfang Horde into the hills and reached a cave, ending as the party confronted hobgoblins and a shadowy draconic figure.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-09: The Floundering Five part 1 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-09: The Floundering Five part 1 - summary
The party followed the shadowy draconic figure into the cavern and were ambushed by hobgoblins and drakes. Patch's light, K'hakkik's vines, Mynah's fireballs and the Vicious Fez's acid cut through waves of hobgoblins, bandits and shadows. A hulking dragonborn, a hobgoblin devastator and the Shadow Master then emerged. K'hakkik fell but was revived by Patch, while the Mangler was struck down and dragged deeper into the lair by the dragonborn, leaving the party to decide whether to rescue him.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-23: The Floundering Four part 2 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-23: The Floundering Four part 2 - summary
The party fled the Hobgoblin Cave under the Shadow Master's pursuit, with Mynah's Command freeing K'hakkik and the Fez sacrificing itself at a web-and-vine chokepoint. The Mangler was left caged and began bargaining with the Shadow Master. The others tracked a smuggler's cart, sent a warning to Sister Gladys, and with Sheriff Rixon's posse stopped it at Harrowfield, finding stolen valuables. Grix, the shadowless kobold driver, dissolved into a shadow during interrogation and Patch destroyed it. The party began preparing a fake shipment to infiltrate the cave and rescue the Mangler.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-06: Spelljammin' Spies - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-06: Spelljammin' Spies - summary
The party debated using the real or a fake crate to ransom the Mangler, who was pledged to Tiamat in a ritual and sent off to smuggle a crate to Varkenhold. They met him on the road, discarded the fake crate, and traveled by rail and the Lamprey to Varkenhold. The Mangler delivered the crate via the Angry Owl and received 150 platinum, ending his binding. The party then followed the cult's armored coach through the Ring Mountains to a lake where an adult black dragon emerged.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-22: Egg Hunt Revised - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-22: Egg Hunt Revised - summary
The party watched a black dragon take a crate at the mountain lake and found the path was an old lightning rail spur. They sent word to Chairman Sansbury, then used Fezzle's scrying to learn crates at Berkenholt held dragon eggs bound for Harrowfield. Deputized by the sheriff, they ambushed the shipment, where Patch's wall of fire started a battle and hatched two drakes. They captured several cultists, two drakes and four intact eggs, while six eggs and two crates burned.

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-03: Interlude--Past As Prologue - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-03: Interlude--Past As Prologue - summary
In a flashback interlude, the young friends in Harrowfield drained the Dragon Well, where a ghostly dragon wormling hatched and possessed Mynah. A year later they helped Fezzle's Uncle Grizzle smuggle disguised potatoes past Farmers' Guild inspectors, ending with Grizzle stripped of guild status. Later a barn collapsed with six inspectors dead and Grizzle gone, and Fezzle remembers nothing. In the present, the party decided to deliver prisoners to Obsidius, seek the Farming Guild's army, and then explore the tunnel.

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-17: Questions and (some) Answers - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-17: Questions and (some) Answers - summary
The party took six captured cultists by train to Heartland Station and met Spotless, who let them interrogate the prisoners. Tarrow revealed the egg-to-Drake operation, and Selvara's mind was absorbed by Nimbrax, revealing the cult's guild infiltration, hierarchy under Agonrain and its control of the Farmers Guild. They sold the intelligence to Isalia, agent of Chairman Sansbury, for 4,000 gold and watched a trap being sprung at Haverford's Haversack. The Starfang Horde is expected to hit Coldwater Cross soon.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-03: "Elite" Operatives - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-03: "Elite" Operatives - summary
The party staked out the Haverford's Haversack dead drop and found the noblewoman was an illusion cast by the halfling Losander. He escaped through the iron golems and teleported away with the tiefling warlock Harike. Inside, the golems knocked out Harike's invisible quasit, and Nimbrax absorbed it, learning her patron is a five-headed dragon. Spotless identified Losander, and Kroald Fortas revealed the Merchant Guild bought Harike's servitude contract and agreed to investigate who did it.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-17: Autognomes Gone Wild! - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-17: Autognomes Gone Wild! - summary
A flashback session showed Patch's past aboard the autognome ship Axiomatic, scouting the Great Modron March. The crew found the derelict Belledawn full of handless corpses and traced the horror to replicating adamantine prosthetic hands bought from a merchant in the past. They destroyed a living claw taken from the quartermaster Anchus. Later the captain and chief artificer took such hands too, causing a mutiny, and Patch's memories were suppressed and he was left on a planetoid for 235 years.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-31: Five Adventurers Walk into a  Boutique - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-31: Five Adventurers Walk into a  Boutique - summary
K'hakkik dug through the Halls of Records and Port Authority logs, finding Harike's lenient sentence and her contract sold to Captain Marcus Ordo of the Fallen Moon. Kroald Fortas, Isolde and Spotless helped identify Lys Meerenfell, exiled on the Rock of Bral, as the true buyer and a possible financier of the Dragon Cult. The party provoked the cult by presenting a dragon coin at a Shining Lys boutique, and then followed a courier into the closed sewers. Mangler smashed a barricade and a door trap exploded, leaving them facing a Dragon Cult warrior and two guard drakes.

chunks.title: Session 2026-04-14: Sewer Shennanigans - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-04-14: Sewer Shennanigans - summary
Following the courier, the party smashed through a fortified sewer door and killed two guard drakes and a tattooed dwarf warrior. In a kobold workshop, kobold inventors activated a zombie-powered mech that killed its creator, and Patch turned the undead within it so it fled. Fezzle took some books and the party moved down another passage. There drakes and a second tattooed warrior ambushed them, killing The Mangler's ape Seven, while a Master Horgath was heard approaching.

chunks.title: Session 2026-04-28: From Sewer Sludge to Astral Shores - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-04-28: From Sewer Sludge to Astral Shores - summary
The party fought Guard Drakes, cultists and the Dragon Chosen in the Obsidius sewers. Mynah's fireballs thinned the cultists, but the Fez was destroyed and Master Horgath wounded The Mangler. Patch banished Horgath, and The Mangler summoned a fire elemental. A bronze dragon spirit manifested through Mynah, repelled the enemies, warned of a greater danger, and pulled the party's spirits into the Astral Plane toward a city of seven towers.

chunks.title: Session 2026-05-12: Harike the Nemesis - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-05-12: Harike the Nemesis - summary
The party's spirits were in the astral plane while the Spirit of Myanthoriax possessed Mynah and destroyed the cultists, killing Master Horgath and the Priestess of Tiamat. The party took kobold prisoners, looted the Amulet of Tiamat, Horgath's flail and helm, and mech parts, and learned of the vampire Lord Red Knight. They were then ambushed by Harike, the Dragon Speaker and Losander, who held Fezzle hostage before The Mangler rescued him. Losander and Harike escaped by teleportation while the party killed the remaining cultists.

chunks.title: Session 2026-05-26: Lord Rednight Requests - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-05-26: Lord Rednight Requests - summary
The party rested in the cult's arcane laboratory and received a polite warning from Scolario, servant of the vampire lord Mr. Rednight. They then ransacked the base, learning of the cult's fruitless Masks of Tiamat search and its Drake egg and troop smuggling. They defeated a slime-fed clay golem guarding the vault, with K'hakkik restraining it and The Mangler delivering the killing blow. In the vault K'hakkik claimed the moon blade Moonstalker among the coins and jewelry, and the party returned to their asteroid base.

chunks.title: Session 2026-06-09: The Traitor - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-06-09: The Traitor - summary
The party spent downtime at their asteroid bastion scribing scrolls, selling the Marvelous Pigments and Hand of Avash, and shopping at Haverford's Haversack. Library research identified the northern lake's black dragon as Agonrain, son of Maulvrath the Ebon Queen. K'hakkik's new Mirror of the Past gave glimpses of Lord Redknight, Harike and others. Losander sent a message claiming he was framed for the Bank of Obsidius heist and offering to betray the cult. Investigating via Spotless, the bank and the Hall of Records led K'hakkik to Aldrich Fenniworth Caule and the gnome Brix.

chunks.title: Session 2026-06-23: Memories and Other Ephemera - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-06-23: Memories and Other Ephemera - summary
The party used Benevio's Orb of Knowing to contact Losander, who blamed Spotless and the bank manager Cauley. At The Healing Mind, Phaelin diagnosed Patch's missing memory crystal, revealed Cauley's two visits on the night of the heist, and restored Fezzle's memory of his uncle Grizzle summoning demons with a Maglubiyet mask. In the Undermarket, gem cutter Teresa Vanek agreed to tip the party off about the final gem handoff. Fezzle scouted the Dragon Cult's northern stronghold, seeing heavy guards, Agonrain being fed, and signs of Harike, before Teresa reported the final gems had arrived early.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-07: Three is the Lonliest Number - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-07: Three is the Lonliest Number - summary
The party raced back to Obsidius and, through Teresa Vanik, learned the gem drop was at Jolly Jewels in Troll Foot Square. A dry run revealed Krug's Ravagers, led by the blackguard Kruug, and Patch's divination hinted at the square's name. A decoy drop with an autognome courier showed the Ravagers were targeting a courier named Farla, implying an inside leak. The party plans to ambush the Brute at dusk.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-21: Burning Down the  House - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-21: Burning Down the  House - summary
In the Low Market of Obsidius, the party tried to abduct Kruug's enforcer, the Brute. Mynah's polymorph revealed him as a wereboar, and he was bound and stripped of his spy's murmur. Kruug arrived on a flaming nightmare with the Hard Case, the Skulker and the Scholar, and a brutal street battle followed. Patch brought Kruug down and K'hakkik's javelin killed the fleeing Scholar, while the Skulker escaped. The party left several buildings burning and hauled the pig-form Brute toward the spelljamming docks.

chunks.title: Session 2026-08-18: We Didn't Start the Fire - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-08-18: We Didn't Start the Fire - summary
After the Low Market battle the party put out a fire, looted the Ravagers and smuggled the bodies to Throm's Anvil, where Nimbrax learned the Ravagers were hired to intercept the courier Farla. K'hakkik's mirror visions tied Farla to the Sansbury family. At Jolly Jewelers Mynah approached Farla openly and she withdrew without the package, agreeing to verify their story. The party met the Pennykeepers, received a note from Silvereyes hinting at reconsidering Losander's conviction, and The Mangler learned at Adamant Arcana that his clan is calling exiles home to a Warpstone-powered asteroid.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-01: ...And called it macaroni ! - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-01: ...And called it macaroni ! - summary
After resting and leveling at Throm's Anvil, the party questioned the captive Brute through Nimbrax and used K'hakkik's mirror and Patch's speak-with-dead to learn about Kruug and his service to Graz'zt. Kruug's spirit offered to help against the dragon cult in exchange for resurrection. At the Pennykeepers' crab feed, Brega, Osric and Petunia supplied leads pointing to Cauley and Storehouse 9. After Farla moved the final gem drop to Scaled Square, the party tracked the gems to Storehouse 9, where K'hakkik opened the doors on a chaotic scene of choking guards and reptiles.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-15: The Battle for Storehouse Nine - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-15: The Battle for Storehouse Nine - summary
The party arrived at Storehouse Nine to find a guard dead and the guards choking in toxic gas, with crocodiles caged and loose. They fought the guards, the Armored Guard, Myca, Sif and Greylinks amid a spirit dragon, summoned beasts and crocodiles enraged by K'hakkik's flaming boots. Myca, Greylinks, Sif and the archer Tiff all escaped. At the end, a ghostly imperial toll collector crossed the water and vanished through a submerged iron door.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-29: A Toll is Taken, and A Toll is Due - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-29: A Toll is Taken, and A Toll is Due - summary
The party contained the chaos at Storehouse 9, draining the crocodile tank while the air elemental chased Sith. Mynah and Fezzle tracked Sith to a restaurant, where Mynah turned her into a turtle. At the storehouse a ghostly toll taker and Sonny Caule rose from the sunken door, and the party drove them off and recovered the gem box. They breached the vault, found Caule's body, and took the body, gems and turtle toward the ship.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-13: Layoffs at the Expeditors Guild - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-13: Layoffs at the Expeditors Guild - summary
The party returned to Throm's Anvil, where Syf reverted from turtle form, was restrained, parleyed and released with a deal. They resurrected Krug and Aldrich Caule; Nimbrax's memory-draining of Krug and Aldrich's compelled confession exposed Spotless as the mastermind behind the bank heist. They delivered a report and Aldrich before Silver Eyes in the King's Tomb, which cleared Losander, paid a two thousand gold reward, and warned that Spotless is now a danger. Losander then reported that the Cult of the Dragon is moving on Columbria after a Ring of Wishes.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-27: Something Smells Funny in Colombria - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-27: Something Smells Funny in Colombria - summary
The party shopped at Haverford's Haversack, then traveled by the Wailing Star and lightning rail to the cliff town of Columbria to find the rumored Ring of Wishes. Locals and Abbot Corwin Halloway largely dismissed the Dragon Cult threat. Losander warned Fezzle of at least three cult spies in town and pointed to the Hollow Cell. Patch's divination with Apollo confirmed the ring exists but is not safe, and his owl spotted candlelight and bones at the Hollow Cell.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - The Dancing Monastery - summary
Morning in Columbria: Patch, Fezzle, K'hakkik, Mangler and Mynah dug into the Hollow Cell, the abandoned monastery Losander had pointed them toward. Hargan and Secretary Brannick gave guarded warnings, and Patch's clairvoyance showed a wrecked monk's cell with old bloodstains. Mangler's distraction plan went wrong when he tore a shutter off and the monastery came alive and swallowed him. Mynah identified it as a haunting revenant, and the party tore the building down with fire, force and steel before it collapsed. A swarm of undead monks and the Hollow Abbot remained, and the Abbot, nearly dead, raised a ringed hand, said 'I wish', and crumbled to dust.
Cliffhanger: The Hollow Abbot has withered to dust after wishing on his ring, the Hollow Monks lie still, and the party, bloodied and exhausted, has not yet learned what he wished for. Mangler still carries the Abbot's vow of revenge.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - Gathering Gossip
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - scene 1: Gathering Gossip
- Patch tells Hargan they viewed the Hollow Cell from a distance, and Hargan says outsiders went there, something bad happened, and nobody has come out since.
- The GM explains that the monks worshiped the Hollow One, Hel, goddess of magic and the dishonored dead, and a contemplative sect focused on the emptiness of death.
- Hargan says the council's watchman has sat out front every day for the twelve years he has lived there.
- At the Chapter House, Secretary Brannick says the monastery is closed for everyone's safety after deaths several years ago.
- Mynah and Patch both read Brannick as holding something back from outsiders, though he is honest about what the records contain.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - Clairvoyance at the Amphitheater
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - scene 2: Clairvoyance at the Amphitheater
- Patch casts clairvoyance from the amphitheater into the cell where the light was seen and finds smashed furniture, a burned desk and chair, and a door off its hinges.
- A 22 on perception reveals the window was broken inward, and old bloodstains that are newer than the fire, including blood on two rafter ends.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - A Plan to Sneak In
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - scene 3: A Plan to Sneak In
- Mynah volunteers to chat up Brother Matthias while Mangler draws attention from the front.
- Mangler walks toward the monastery, waving and posing while Matthias watches through a spyglass and records him in his book.
- Mangler activates his boots of flying and goes over the wall into the courtyard while Fezzle, Patch and K'hakkik circle around the back.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - The Distraction
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - scene 4: The Distraction
- Mynah meets Brother Matthias on the road, and Matthias laments the loss of Mynah's friend and refuses to share details.
- In the courtyard, Mangler pries a shutter off with a 23 on athletics, and the monastery inhales and pulls at his soul.
- Mangler fails his Charisma save and climbs inside, the window vanishes, and a rafter slams him for 25 bludgeoning.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - The Building Fights Back
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - scene 5: The Building Fights Back
- Fezzle recalls a legend of a witch coven's hut animated by a curse, and Patch tries remove curse through the owl with no effect.
- Mynah identifies the building as a haunting revenant that must be destroyed to free its victims.
- Fezzle orders the Fez to attack the wall and it fails, and K'hakkik's conjure barrage knocks off a few stones.
- The building critically hits the Fez for 51 damage, leaving it at 1 hit point, and a shower of roof tiles hits K'hakkik for 28.
- Mynah drops fireballs on the back of the building.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - The Hollow Abbot
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - scene 6: The Hollow Abbot
- The Hollow Abbot lays a vow of revenge on Mangler so he always knows where Mangler is, and Mangler resists its glare repeatedly.
- The building pulls K'hakkik and Fezzle inside, and Patch resists.
- K'hakkik hacks through a support timber and the building becomes bloodied.
- A final chop through a central beam, after K'hakkik's critical hit, brings the monastery down.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - Swarm and Wish
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - scene 7: Swarm and Wish
- Mynah's fireball hits the Abbot for 42 and the swarm for 21.
- The swarm grapples and suffocates Mangler and K'hakkik, while Fezzle drifts in and out of the Ethereal Plane with blink.
- The nearly destroyed Abbot raises a hand with a ring and says 'I wish'.
- The Abbot collapses to dust and the Hollow Monks fall, and the GM says what he wished for will wait until next time.

chunks.title: Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2026-11-10: Too Bad We Can't Stay! - memorable quotes
- "A particular branch of hell worshipers who contemplate the emptiness of death." - GM (Kyle)
- "I'm a birder recording an unusual species vibe." - GM (Kyle)
- "The more Kyle talks about it, the more we think we're supposed to go there." - Fezzle (Dave)
- "If that's what it was, I would've totally done that." - Mangler (John)
- "I have defeated a building." - K'hakkik (Robert)
- "I wish." - Hollow Abbot (Kyle)
- "Congratulations. You defeated a building." - GM (Kyle)

chunks.title: Umber hulks
chunks.text:
NPC: Umber hulks (first seen 2025-01-21, last seen 2025-01-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Monsters that attacked the travelers
Location: Wasteland
- (2025-01-21) The travelers had been attacked by umber hulks, and they shared information about them with the party.

chunks.title: Crawling Queen
chunks.text:
NPC: Crawling Queen (first seen 2025-01-21, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Valara the Crawling Queen
Role: One of the six Dalekir (Lords of Madness)
- (2025-01-21) The Crawling Queen's minions destroyed the True Steel Forge.
- (2025-06-03) Her influence is suspected to lie through the portal to Zoriat.

chunks.title: Duergar Warriors
chunks.text:
NPC: Duergar Warriors (first seen 2025-02-04, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Duergar, dark dwarves
Role: Dark dwarf soldiers defending the Forge with ballistas, melee, enlargement and invisibility
Location: The Forge and the Ballista Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive; battle unfinished
- (2025-02-04) Duergar Warriors waited behind barricades with ballistas in the Duergar Defense Room.
- (2025-02-04) Two Duergar Warriors grew to the size of ogres during combat.
- (2025-02-04) Some Duergar Warriors turned invisible to gain tactical advantage, and Mangler's tremor sense tracked them.
- (2025-02-04) One Duergar Warrior fled invisibly to the Hallway with Well and broke open a door, releasing Skeletons.
- (2025-02-04) Mangler found a barracks where six Duergar Warriors were helping a seventh into mechanized construct armor.
- (2025-02-04) The Duergar Warriors had taken residence in the Forge.
- (2025-02-18) The party fought the duergar at the forge complex entrance, using a ballista against them.
- (2025-02-18) Several duergar enlarged themselves and attacked with javelins and direct attacks.
- (2025-02-18) A ballista bolt struck through one duergar's head.
- (2025-02-18) The party won the battle against the duergar.
- (2025-02-18) The party recovered 170 gold in coins and 125 gold in trinkets from the fallen duergar.
- (2025-06-03) The Duergar had withdrawn from the forge by the time the party returned from Smudgekeep.

chunks.title: Hooded Duergar
chunks.text:
NPC: Hooded Duergar (first seen 2025-02-04, last seen 2025-02-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Robed duergar spellcaster who commands the defenders
Location: The Forge
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-02-04) The Hooded Duergar tried to escape to the south but was intercepted by Mangler.
- (2025-02-04) The Hooded Duergar uses psychic abilities and can turn invisible.
- (2025-02-04) The Hooded Duergar owns a returning dagger.
- (2025-02-18) Deep Lord Bloodhammer's orders, written in Undercommon, were found on a hooded duergar.

chunks.title: Skeletons
chunks.text:
NPC: Skeletons (first seen 2025-02-04, last seen 2025-02-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Undead former inhabitants of the Forge, wielding rusty blades
Location: The Forge and the Ballista Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: some turned and fled
- (2025-02-04) A group of Skeletons was released into the fight when a Duergar Warrior broke open a door.
- (2025-02-04) Patch successfully turned several undead, who fled in terror.
- (2025-02-04) One Skeleton exploded on death in a twenty-foot radius that caught multiple combatants.
- (2025-02-18) The party encountered and defeated a group of frightened skeletons in former barracks.
- (2025-02-18) The skeletons' remains were identified as citizens of Obsidius.

chunks.title: Flaming Skeleton
chunks.text:
NPC: Flaming Skeleton (first seen 2025-02-04, last seen 2025-02-04) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Flaming Hammer Creature
Role: Undead smith infused with fire magic, wearing a smith's apron and wielding a flaming hammer
Location: The Forge / Ballista Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive; threatening Mangler at session end
- (2025-02-04) The Flaming Skeleton can throw fire and explodes when destroyed.
- (2025-02-04) At the end of the session the hammer-wielding creature threatened Mangler.

chunks.title: Deep Lord Bloodhammer
chunks.text:
NPC: Deep Lord Bloodhammer (first seen 2025-02-18, last seen 2025-02-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Duergar leader who sent written orders to seize the forge complex
Faction: Duergar
- (2025-02-18) Deep Lord Bloodhammer's written orders demanded the duergar either claim the forge complex for war against surface dwellers or destroy it completely.
- (2025-02-18) The orders acknowledged the complex's dangerous reputation from its previous occupation by hostile forces.

chunks.title: Forge Master
chunks.text:
NPC: Forge Master (first seen 2025-02-18, last seen 2025-02-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Former leader of the forge complex and devoted follower of Vulcan
Location: The Forge
Status: Undead
- (2025-02-18) The Forge Master was deceived by a demon impersonating Vulcan, which cursed him to become one with the forge's flame upon death.
- (2025-02-18) His journals reveal an increasing obsession with fire and the forge before his transformation into an undead entity.

chunks.title: Giant Spider
chunks.text:
NPC: Giant Spider (first seen 2025-03-04, last seen 2025-04-01) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Ethereal Spider, Phase Spider
Role: Horse-sized spider that can turn invisible or ethereal
Location: Chasm Bridge
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-03-04) The party spotted the horse-sized spider on the webbed bridge.
- (2025-03-04) It uses webs beneath the bridge to catch flying prey.
- (2025-03-18) GMAssistant identified the horse-sized spider as a phase spider that can move between planes and hunt by ambush.
- (2025-03-18) Its paralyzing venom incapacitates rather than kills prey.
- (2025-03-18) Phase spiders can communicate telepathically despite lacking speech.
- (2025-03-18) Phase spiders can catch and eat ghosts.
- (2025-03-18) A phase spider scored a critical hit on K'hakkik, poisoning and paralyzing him.
- (2025-03-18) The party defeated several spiders in the battle, and some fell into the depths below.
- (2025-04-01) A phase spider briefly appeared during the party's night of rest in the machine shop.

chunks.title: Spider Minions
chunks.text:
NPC: Spider Minions (first seen 2025-03-04, last seen 2025-03-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Medium Phase Spiders
Role: Human-sized spiders accompanying the giant spider
Location: Chasm Bridge
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-03-04) Several human-sized spiders were seen patrolling and crawling on the webs around the bridge.
- (2025-03-18) Several medium-sized phase spiders fought alongside the large one on the bridge.
- (2025-03-18) The party killed several of the spiders, and some fell into the chasm.

chunks.title: Poltergeist
chunks.text:
NPC: Poltergeist (first seen 2025-03-18, last seen 2025-03-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Invisible spirit haunting the magical study room
Location: Magical Study Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-03-18) The poltergeist became angry when the party began taking items from the study.
- (2025-03-18) It violently threw metal ingots and papers around the room in a tornado-like swirl with no wind felt.
- (2025-03-18) It cannot pursue targets beyond the room's doors.

chunks.title: Three Person Council
chunks.text:
NPC: Three Person Council (first seen 2025-03-18, last seen 2025-05-20) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Council of Three
Role: Former ruling body of True Steel Forge
Faction: True Steel Forge
- (2025-03-18) The council consisted of master smiths specializing in hammers, swords, and spears.
- (2025-03-18) Decisions in the ruling chamber required majority rule.
- (2025-05-20) Letters in the living quarters showed disagreement about the council's leadership.
- (2025-05-20) The council was described as inefficient because two members had to agree to get anything done.
- (2025-05-20) Some inhabitants preferred a single overlord system.

chunks.title: Warped Duergar
chunks.text:
NPC: Warped Duergar (first seen 2025-04-01, last seen 2025-04-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Twisted duergar warriors that appear to be two beings fused together, with multiple arms, legs and distorted features
Location: Courtyard
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-04-01) The party fought grotesquely fused duergar in the courtyard.
- (2025-04-01) They fought with weapons including war picks and javelins.
- (2025-04-01) They appeared to be in distress from their warped state.

chunks.title: Warped Seer
chunks.text:
NPC: Warped Seer (first seen 2025-04-01, last seen 2025-04-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Corrupted duergar mystic with tentacles under its cloak; capable of psychic attacks and mind control, including forcing allies to attack each other
Location: Courtyard
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-04-01) Mynah's Web spells helped contain the Warped Seer and its winged leader.
- (2025-04-01) The Warped Seer manifested psychic blades.

chunks.title: Winged Mutant Leader
chunks.text:
NPC: Winged Mutant Leader (first seen 2025-04-01, last seen 2025-04-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Transformed elf or drow with multiple wings along its back, lean whip-like muscles and cold intelligence; commands other warped creatures and fires psychic blasts that invoke nightmares
Location: Courtyard
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-04-01) It led the warped creatures against the party in the courtyard.

chunks.title: Living Brazier Spirits
chunks.text:
NPC: Living Brazier Spirits (first seen 2025-04-01, last seen 2025-04-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Sentient fire creatures inhabiting the courtyard braziers, alive and conscious
Location: Courtyard
Attitude to party: non-hostile
- (2025-04-01) The brazier spirits were observed to be alive and conscious but did not attack.

chunks.title: Trapped Spirits
chunks.text:
NPC: Trapped Spirits (first seen 2025-04-01, last seen 2025-04-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Mindless, tortured spirits bound by ethereal webs, in distress from their violent deaths and imprisonment
- (2025-04-01) The spirits were found bound by ethereal webs.

chunks.title: Tentacled Horror
chunks.text:
NPC: Tentacled Horror (first seen 2025-04-01, last seen 2025-04-15) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Beholder-like creature with a large beak and thorned tentacles that grab, poison and paralyze; 15-foot reach
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-04-01) It ambushed the party after their rest and seized Fezzle with its tentacles.
- (2025-04-01) Fezzle was left suspended in the air, poisoned and paralyzed, at the end of the session.
- (2025-04-15) (GMA) It was a Grell about twice normal size, 10 feet across, hovering 20 feet up and holding Fezzle 15 feet in the air.
- (2025-04-15) (GMA) Fezzle succumbed to its paralyzing tentacles and fell unconscious.
- (2025-04-15) (GMA) The party defeated it using ranged attacks, Mynah's web spell and Patch's readied healing magic.

chunks.title: Mimic
chunks.text:
NPC: Mimic (first seen 2025-04-15, last seen 2025-05-20) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Ambush predator disguised as a trapped chest in a rubble pile
Location: Warehouse
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-04-15) Fezzle tried to pick its lock and became stuck to it.
- (2025-04-15) It changed into a teddy bear shape during the fight.
- (2025-04-15) It had deliberately arranged its rubble hiding place to ambush adventurers.
- (2025-04-15) The party defeated it and found an adamantine-alloy dagger in its remains.
- (2025-05-20) A second mimic revealed itself in the warehouse when Fezzle tried to pick the lock on a suspicious chest, and it attacked.
- (2025-05-20) K'hakkik attacked it fiercely with multiple weapon strikes and the party defeated it.

chunks.title: Tiny Fire Elementals
chunks.text:
NPC: Tiny Fire Elementals (first seen 2025-04-15, last seen 2025-04-15) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Fire elementals
Role: Four small sentient fire beings living in the braziers of the Vulcan temple
Location: Vulcan Temple
Attitude to party: curious, non-hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-04-15) Mynah tried to communicate with them.
- (2025-04-15) They showed interest in offerings burned in their bowls.

chunks.title: Duergrim Warriors
chunks.text:
NPC: Duergrim Warriors (first seen 2025-04-15, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Durgrim warriors, Durgrims
Role: Four-armed warped duergar guarding the ritual casters
Faction: Duergar cultists
Location: Courtyard
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-04-15) They fought with crossbows, javelins, shields and melee weapons to defend the ritual.
- (2025-05-20) Multiple four-armed Durgrims with war picks, javelins and crossbows emerged from doorways and attacked the party in the courtyard.
- (2025-05-20) Mynah's Fear spell made several enemies flee and drop their weapons.
- (2025-05-20) The battle was left unfinished at the end of the session.
- (2025-06-03) Some Durgrims fled under fear magic and dropped their equipment.
- (2025-06-03) K'hakkik killed one Durgrim with precise strikes.
- (2025-06-03) Durgrims were found hiding under beds in the dormitory rooms; Mynah spotted two of them.
- (2025-06-03) K'hakkik killed the Durgrim that emerged to attack.

chunks.title: Duergaunt Cultists
chunks.text:
NPC: Duergaunt Cultists (first seen 2025-04-15, last seen 2025-05-20) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Durgaunt ritual casters
Role: Hooded tentacled duergar performing the ritual on the forge elemental
Faction: Duergar cultists
Location: Courtyard
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-04-15) They maintained concentration on the ritual to suppress the forge elemental's power.
- (2025-04-15) Patch's study of the ritual revealed that breaking their concentration would free the elemental.
- (2025-05-20) Tentacled Durgaunts fought alongside the Durgrims in the courtyard.
- (2025-05-20) A Durgaunt grappled Patch, causing Patch to lose concentration on Spirit Guardians.

chunks.title: Mutate Lord
chunks.text:
NPC: Mutate Lord (first seen 2025-04-15, last seen 2025-04-15) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Flying aberration leading the duergar cultists
Faction: Duergar cultists
Location: Forge Chamber
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-04-15) It fired nightmare blasts from its eyes and fought in melee.
- (2025-04-15) Patch's blindness spell gave the party an advantage against it.
- (2025-04-15) It was set on fire and killed by the forge elemental's 32-damage hammer blow.

chunks.title: Forge Elemental
chunks.text:
NPC: Forge Elemental (first seen 2025-04-15, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Essence of forging, single-mindedly focused on restoring the forge
Location: Ancient forge room
Attitude to party: eager to see the forge restored
Status: alive
- (2025-04-15) It was trapped and tortured by the cultists' ritual inside the Vulcan head statue.
- (2025-04-15) Once freed it wielded a massive flaming forge hammer and helped kill the Mutate Lord.
- (2025-04-15) After the victory it turned menacingly toward the party.
- (2025-05-20) Mynah approached it peacefully and communicated with it in Draconic.
- (2025-05-20) It desperately wanted the forge restored to working order.
- (2025-05-20) It gave the party a tour showing extensive damage throughout the facility.
- (2025-05-20) Patch attempted to heal it as a gesture of goodwill, but it was not injured.
- (2025-05-20) It showed growing impatience with mortal weaknesses such as the need for rest.
- (2025-05-20) It focused on repairing the damaged statue of Vulcan and pointed out damaged pillars, tracks and storage areas.
- (2025-05-20) It revealed the existence of a treasury and warehouse but seemed focused solely on the forge room.
- (2025-05-20) Asked its name, it initially called itself 'Mortals'.
- (2025-05-20) It speaks Draconic and some Common.
- (2025-06-03) Fezzle commissioned adamantine badges shaped like the Forge Elemental for the party.

chunks.title: Zadik
chunks.text:
NPC: Zadik (first seen 2025-05-20, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Zadik Fireheart
Role: Older priest of Vulcan and high priest of the Temple of Vulcan in Yogbor
Faction: Temple of Vulcan
Attitude to party: supportive
- (2025-05-20) Zadik offered to grant proven status in the Temple of Vulcan for clearing and consecrating the dungeon to Vulcan.
- (2025-06-03) Zadik helped consecrate the forge and supported Patch's proving.
- (2025-06-03) Zadik offered the party temple lodging.

chunks.title: Ghost Leaders
chunks.text:
NPC: Ghost Leaders (first seen 2025-06-03, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Former leaders who seek revenge on aberrations
Location: Great Hall
- (2025-06-03) Three ghostly figures, two dwarves and a human, sat on giant-sized thrones in the circular hall.
- (2025-06-03) They killed many Dolgrims and Dolgaunts with necrotic damage.

chunks.title: True Steel Mining Consortium Members
chunks.text:
NPC: True Steel Mining Consortium Members (first seen 2025-06-03, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: True Steel Consortium
Faction: True Steel Mining Consortium
Location: Yogbor
Attitude to party: celebratory
- (2025-06-03) The consortium moved in to protect the Vulcan priests during the consecration of the forge.
- (2025-06-03) The party gained renown with the consortium.

chunks.title: Rail Guild Members
chunks.text:
NPC: Rail Guild Members (first seen 2025-06-03, last seen 2025-06-03) [unconfirmed record]
Location: Yogbor
Attitude to party: displeased
- (2025-06-03) Rail Guild members gave the party side-eye because they will lose business now that ore processing can happen locally.

chunks.title: Kroald Fortas
chunks.text:
NPC: Kroald Fortas (first seen 2025-06-17, last seen 2026-03-31) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Dragonborn examiner at the Arcanists Guild
Faction: Arcanists Guild
Attitude to party: Cooperative
Status: alive
Location: Obsidius
- (2025-06-17) Kroald received Mynah's report about aberrations.
- (2025-06-17) Kroald explained the Daelkir and the gatekeeper seals, estimating six or seven more seals scattered across the world.
- (2025-06-17) Kroald revealed that Zuggtmoy, also known as Avash, is one of these ancient horrors.
- (2025-06-17) Kroald smells of sandalwood and lavender and is likely an adventurer himself.
- (2025-09-16) Kroald showed dangerous interest in replicating the helm fusion experiment.
- (2025-09-16) He provided analysis of the cult situation and seemed to be speaking honestly.
- (2025-09-30) Kroald gave Mynah a letter of introduction to help arrange the meeting with the Merchant Guild chairman.
- (2025-09-30) Kroald has no direct high Merchant Guild contacts but is known and willing to help.
- (2025-11-11) The party sent Kroald Fortas a letter asking about Freylin's past tenure with the Arcanists Guild and his suitability for employment.
- (2025-11-11) Freylin was previously disproven for appropriating guild funds and resources.
- (2026-03-03) Kroald met Mynah and Patch in a secure room at the Arcanists Guild and confirmed Harike's identity.
- (2026-03-03) Kroald agreed to discreetly research who in the Merchant Guild bought Harike's contract and to send word within a few days.

chunks.title: Kroald Fortas (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Kroald Fortas (first seen 2025-06-17, last seen 2026-03-31) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-03-03) Kroald said the Dragon Cult can only be pruned, never fully pulled, and that he disliked Harike personally.
- (2026-03-31) Kroald corrected his earlier information and revealed Lys Meerenfell bought Harike's contract.

chunks.title: Spelljammer Guild Clerk
chunks.text:
NPC: Spelljammer Guild Clerk (first seen 2025-06-17, last seen 2025-06-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Clerk handling proving applications
Faction: Spelljammer Guild
Location: Aether Spire
Attitude to party: Sarcastic
- (2025-06-17) She explained the bureaucratic process for spelljammer proving and the long waits due to insufficient aspirants.
- (2025-06-17) She initially tried to put Mangler on a waiting list.

chunks.title: Captain Threx
chunks.text:
NPC: Captain Threx (first seen 2025-06-17, last seen 2025-09-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Threx
Role: Gruff ship captain
Faction: Spelljammer Guild (confrontational relationship)
Location: Wailing Star
Attitude to party: Seeks crew; cooperative
Status: alive, rescued
- (2025-06-17) Threx has a milky glass eye and a scowl and smokes from his nostrils.
- (2025-06-17) Threx stormed out of the Spelljammer Guild office seeking crew to hunt the pirate ship Wailing Star.
- (2025-06-17) The Guild does not believe his reports.
- (2025-06-17) Threx owns the ramshackle Plan C and prefers chains over ropes.
- (2025-06-17) Threx operated the Plan C's ballista against the Wailing Star, dealing significant damage to its nose ballista.
- (2025-06-17) The Plan C broke apart in the void and Threx ended up aboard the Wailing Star with the party.
- (2025-08-19) Nimbrax was said to apparently owe Threx a ship.
- (2025-09-16) The party rescued Threx and the Rising Star crew from being stranded in space.
- (2025-09-16) Threx demanded his original helm back, and the party negotiated over helm ownership.
- (2025-09-16) Threx sponsored The Mangler for proving in the Spelljammers Guild.

chunks.title: Captain Vance
chunks.text:
NPC: Captain Vance (first seen 2025-06-17, last seen 2025-06-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Former captain of the Wailing Star who apparently turned pirate
- (2025-06-17) Threx did not know Vance personally but had heard his name.
- (2025-06-17) The ship's crew was not known to be disposed to piracy, so the turn was unexpected.

chunks.title: Rising Star Crew
chunks.text:
NPC: Rising Star Crew (first seen 2025-06-17, last seen 2025-09-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Six survivors, elves and humans, from the derelict Rising Star
Location: Rising Star
Attitude to party: Confused, aimless
Status: alive, rescued
- (2025-06-17) The survivors had sparse, incoherent thoughts and could barely communicate after an unknown attack.
- (2025-06-17) One woman in uniform seems to be the former officer but could barely focus on memories of the attack.
- (2025-06-17) They have bloodstains on their clothes but are not significantly physically injured.
- (2025-09-16) The party retrieved the Rising Star and its crew from space.

chunks.title: Mynah's Family
chunks.text:
NPC: Mynah's Family (first seen 2025-06-17, last seen 2025-06-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Farming family
Location: Heartland
- (2025-06-17) They became the richest family in town thanks to Mynah's remittances of 200 gold.

chunks.title: Nimbrax
chunks.text:
NPC: Nimbrax (first seen 2025-07-01, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: the ship's mind, the helm mass, Nimraux, Nimrax, Nymbrax
Role: Sentient helm mind of the Wailing Star, now power source for the mobile asteroid Throm's Anvil
Location: Throm's Anvil
Attitude to party: Allied
Status: alive
- (2025-07-01) Mynah cast detect thoughts and found an extra mind aboard that spoke telepathically of constant hunger and a need for more helms.
- (2025-07-01) Nimbrax claimed it had always existed this way and had no memory of its origin.
- (2025-07-01) It named itself after a mind flayer whose consciousness it absorbed; having a name means it knows more and feels less hungry.
- (2025-07-01) The Mangler tried to attune to the backup helm and contest Nimbrax; he failed the constitution contest, gained a level of exhaustion and lost his attunement.
- (2025-07-01) Nimbrax probed the Mangler's mind and learned of the Forge Helm in his dwarven citadel.
- (2025-07-01) Its psychic waves forced charisma saves, dealing psychic damage and making party members forget their actions.
- (2025-07-01) It telepathically commanded the party to 'stop and be crew together'.
- (2025-07-01) The Mangler called for parlay and Nimbrax agreed, ending the psychic attacks.
- (2025-07-01) Nimbrax admitted it would likely resort to mental domination again if faced with serious disagreement.
- (2025-07-01) It agreed to be taken to Throm's Anvil for its pocket sun, hoping to stop feeding on living beings.

chunks.title: Nimbrax (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Nimbrax (first seen 2025-07-01, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-07-22) The party decided to return to the ship to consult Nimbrax about installation options instead of rushing the installation.
- (2025-07-22) Nimbrax has built itself into a forge helm class device.
- (2025-08-19) Nimbrax piloted the ship into the darkness four miles from Throm's Anvil, where the party rested without being detected.
- (2025-08-19) Nimbrax approached Throm's Anvil undetected a second time before lookouts spotted activity.
- (2025-08-19) Nimbrax's automated ballistas and mangonel hit the vampirate galleon, destroying vampirates in puffs of black smoke.
- (2025-08-19) Nimbrax's mangonel scored a critical hit for 69 damage on the galleon.
- (2025-08-19) Nimbrax's attempt to grapple the invisible galleon with its jaws failed.
- (2025-08-19) Nimbrax was said to apparently owe a ship to Threx, mentioned in passing during planning.
- (2025-09-02) Nimbrax boarded the galleon and unleashed a psychic wave after warning the party, stunning many vampirates and destroying some weaker shadows.
- (2025-09-02) Nimbrax fired ballistas that tore through the vampirate ranks, and one bolt landing near Fezzle freed him from hypnotic pattern.
- (2025-09-02) The party planned for Nimbrax to guard the captured galleon during the tower assault.
- (2025-09-16) The Mangler installed Nimbrax into the magical circle connected to the pocket sun, granting it immense power.
- (2025-09-16) Nimbrax restored the crew of the Wailing Star to life, including Captain Araya, who had been trapped as zombies.

chunks.title: Nimbrax (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Nimbrax (first seen 2025-07-01, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-09-16) Nimbrax moved the entire asteroid through space, giving the party a mobile base.
- (2025-09-16) Nimbrax stores the minds of various crews, including murderous pirates and illithids, according to Daelen.
- (2025-09-16) Nimbrax had disabled Threx's vessel and killed his crew.

chunks.title: Sister Gladys
chunks.text:
NPC: Sister Gladys (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Gladys
Role: Goliath conductor on the Shadewater to Northern Line run
Faction: Rail Guild
Attitude to party: Cooperative
Status: alive
Location: Heartland Station
- (2025-11-11) Gladys reported smaller-than-usual shipments from the interior, especially Heartland Station, and more kobold passengers.
- (2025-11-11) Gladys said private freight cars booked from Shadewater to Greenway go uninspected if enough is paid, and these had become more frequent.
- (2025-11-11) Gladys first thought the Cult of the Dragon defunct but was convinced by Mynah's earnestness.
- (2025-11-11) The party asked Gladys to watch for suspicious activity and report to Sunny Stone or the Proof Tavern.
- (2025-11-11) Mynah asked Gladys to inform her superiors if the party did not return, but to wait a couple of weeks.
- (2025-12-23) Patch sent Gladys a Sending warning of dragon cultist contraband in a five-foot crate bound for the Heartland railhead.
- (2025-12-23) Gladys replied she was at Heartland Station and would search as many crates as feasible, ending with 'Good luck, don't die.'
- (2026-01-06) The party prepared a sealed envelope on the cult's location and members for Gladys, to open only if they failed to return.
- (2026-01-06) The party agreed to inform Gladys of their plan to use the real crate as bait.
- (2026-01-22) Mynah sent a warning to Gladys about the suspicious cargo and she replied with shock and profanity about dragon eggs.

chunks.title: Grimble
chunks.text:
NPC: Grimble (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Hedge wizard acting as sending 'telegraph station'
Location: Alderdale
Status: alive
- (2025-11-11) Grimble relayed an urgent sending to Fezzle that his grandmother wanted him home because of a problem.

chunks.title: Master Grynd
chunks.text:
NPC: Master Grynd (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Kobold merchant who runs a shop supplying surface goods
Faction: Merchants Guild
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-11-11) Grynd recognized Mynah on the train and told him Greenway towns were robbed by an organized force of hobgoblins, kobolds, brigands and dragon-like creatures that sought portable valuables.
- (2025-11-11) Grynd said the dragons were small, did not use breath weapons, and may have been drakes.
- (2025-11-11) Mynah gave Grynd 100 gold for his family, 10 platinum for those in need in Harrowfield, and 15 gold to upgrade Grynd's fare to second class.
- (2025-11-11) Grynd confirmed Alderdale was robbed the same way, with raiders using the Greenway Road but not seen at Greenway Station.

chunks.title: Mayor Gronzel
chunks.text:
NPC: Mayor Gronzel (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Bugbear mayor of Alderdale and Farmer's Guild representative
Faction: Farmer's Guild
Location: Alderdale
Attitude to party: Friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-11-11) Gronzel said Alderdale was hit hard by numerous hobgoblins using devastating magic, many died, and some young residents ran away possibly to join them.
- (2025-11-11) Gronzel said Fezzle's family farm was spared because they surrendered immediately.
- (2025-11-11) Gronzel said the raiders had large lizards resembling black dragons that did not fly or breathe fire and killed cattle.
- (2025-11-11) Gronzel offered the party the full Mercenary Guild contract payment if they resolve the raiders before mercenaries are hired, or half if after signing but before mercenaries arrive.
- (2025-11-11) Mynah declared the party would solve the raider problem and the party accepted the contract.

chunks.title: Mama Grivy
chunks.text:
NPC: Mama Grivy (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Goblin farmer, Fezzle's mother
Location: Fezzle's Family Farm
Status: alive
- (2025-11-11) Mama Grivy put the party to work bucking hay for an hour before feeding them.
- (2025-11-11) Grivy recalled barn damage the night Fezzle's uncle died that Fezzle could not have caused, and Farmer's Guild members among the dead.
- (2025-11-11) Fezzle gave Grivy 200 gold for the family.

chunks.title: Snort
chunks.text:
NPC: Snort (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Goblin cousin of Fezzle
Location: Fezzle's Family Farm
- (2025-11-11) Snort recounted the raid with fear and awe and said the hobgoblins worshipped Lubiat, the usurper goblin god.

chunks.title: Pibble
chunks.text:
NPC: Pibble (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Goblin cousin of Fezzle
Location: Fezzle's Family Farm
- (2025-11-11) Pibble helped Snort describe the organized hobgoblin raid.

chunks.title: Grandma Zazzle
chunks.text:
NPC: Grandma Zazzle (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Fezzle's grandmother, thought by some to be a witch
Location: Fezzle's Family Farm
- (2025-11-11) Zazzle muttered that the raiders were trying to recruit children.
- (2025-11-11) Zazzle had Grimble send for Fezzle because she knew he had powerful friends.

chunks.title: Kruzzle
chunks.text:
NPC: Kruzzle (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Goblin farmer, Fezzle's father
Location: Fezzle's Family Farm
- (2025-11-11) Kruzzle was surprised by the party's visit and believes the raids are only the beginning.
- (2025-11-11) Kruzzle did not recognize the creature with forearms and pincers that Fezzle asked about.

chunks.title: Shadowy Draconic Figure
chunks.text:
NPC: Shadowy Draconic Figure (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: half-dragon figure, Shadow Master
Role: Lean half-dragon with smoke-colored scales; true believer who runs the cave smuggling operation
Faction: Starfang Horde
Location: Hobgoblin Cave
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-11-11) The figure, cloaked in living shadow, watched a cart leave the cave and then retreated inside.
- (2025-11-11) The figure spun to face the party at the cavemouth as shadows gathered around it.
- (2025-12-09) The figure, called the Shadow Master, led the initial ambush in the cavern and speaks Undercommon and Draconic.
- (2025-12-09) The Shadow Master emerged in the larger chamber alongside the hulking dragonborn and the hobgoblin devastator.
- (2025-12-09) The Mangler leapt to engage the Shadow Master and was struck down.
- (2025-12-23) The Shadow Master broke free of the magical webs and pursued the party, leaping thirty feet toward Mynah.
- (2025-12-23) Patch's Gem of Brightness blinded the Shadow Master mid-leap after it resisted the first attempt.
- (2025-12-23) The Shadow Master clawed Mynah for slashing and necrotic damage.
- (2025-12-23) The Fez dealt the Shadow Master the first damage it took in the battle before the Shadow Master and Guard Drakes destroyed the Fez.
- (2025-12-23) The Shadow Master questioned the Mangler in captivity and became very interested when the Mangler mentioned spelljammers for point-to-point delivery.

chunks.title: Shadowy Draconic Figure (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Shadowy Draconic Figure (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-12-23) The Shadow Master said the cave packages goods for transshipment and enforces deals by taking the shadows of those who work for him, so he can harm them if they betray him.

chunks.title: Hobgoblins
chunks.text:
NPC: Hobgoblins (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Hobgoblin Warriors
Role: Disciplined soldiers forming the bulk of the enemy force, fighting with longbows and longswords
Faction: Starfang Horde
Location: Hobgoblin Cavern
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-11-11) Patch and Mangler recognized the hobgoblins' star sigil with a pronounced lower point as the Starfang Horde, pirates from Bral Space.
- (2025-11-11) The party estimated the raiders' camp held about 40 hobgoblins, 20 brigands, 20 kobolds and 6 drake-like creatures.
- (2025-11-11) A half-dozen hobgoblins guarded the cave entrance when the party arrived.
- (2025-12-09) Hobgoblins ambushed the party in the cavern and fought in formation under a bugbear and a captain.
- (2025-12-09) Patch's flash of light disoriented several hobgoblins, and K'hakkik's vines entangled many of them.
- (2025-12-09) Mynah's first fireball incinerated most of the hobgoblins.
- (2025-12-23) K'hakkik knocked a hobgoblin unconscious non-lethally with his short sword and scimitar during the retreat.
- (2025-12-23) Hobgoblin forces burned through the webs with torches and candles to pursue the party.
- (2025-12-23) The Mangler perceived that the hobgoblins are mercenaries working for coin.

chunks.title: Glabrezu
chunks.text:
NPC: Glabrezu (first seen 2025-11-11, last seen 2025-11-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Demon from Fezzle's past
- (2025-11-11) Patch and Mynah identified the creature Fezzle described as a Glabrezu, a four-armed dog-headed demon of deceit.

chunks.title: Guard Drake
chunks.text:
NPC: Guard Drake (first seen 2025-12-09, last seen 2026-04-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Shock troops and guard animals of the hobgoblins
Location: Cultist Sewers
Status: Several killed; more alive at session end
- (2025-12-09) A medium-sized, wingless draconic beast with glossy black scales that responds to simple commands.
- (2025-12-09) A drake was entangled by K'hakkik's vines and another guard drake joined the fight later.
- (2025-12-23) Patch blinded another Guard Drake with the Gem of Brightness.
- (2025-12-23) K'hakkik's entangling plants restrained several Guard Drakes, though one blind drake avoided them.
- (2025-12-23) Guard Drakes helped destroy the Fez.
- (2026-03-31) Two guard drakes and a Dragon Cult warrior confronted the party in the sewers after the trap went off.
- (2026-04-14) Two guard drakes and a tattooed dwarf warrior waited behind the fortified door; Mynah incinerated one drake and delivered the final blast on the other.
- (2026-04-14) A black-scaled guard drake stood watch in the kobold workshop.
- (2026-04-14) A guard drake ambushed The Mangler from the murky sewer water and was quickly killed.
- (2026-04-14) More drakes burst from the water to attack Mynah, Fezzle and the Fez beside a second tattooed warrior.
- (2026-04-14) Some drakes were of a purer black dragon lineage and dripped acid from their teeth.
- (2026-04-28) The drakes swam and hid in the chest-deep sewer water to attack the party.
- (2026-04-28) K'hakkik, Fezzle and Mynah each killed a drake in the sewer fight.
- (2026-04-28) Mynah's fireballs destroyed more drakes.

chunks.title: Bugbear Warrior
chunks.text:
NPC: Bugbear Warrior (first seen 2025-12-09, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Directs the hobgoblins and bandits
Faction: Hobgoblin forces
Location: Hobgoblin Cavern
Status: alive
- (2025-12-09) He wields two magical returning hammers and seemed focused on capturing strong opponents like K'hakkik rather than killing them.
- (2025-12-09) A bugbear dragged the Mangler into the back of the cavern while the Mangler sought the enemy spellcaster.
- (2025-12-23) The bugbear grabbed K'hakkik a second time as he fled.
- (2025-12-23) Mynah's Command spell 'Grovel' forced the bugbear to its knees and made it release K'hakkik.
- (2025-12-23) The bugbear got back up and resumed chasing the party.

chunks.title: Bandits
chunks.text:
NPC: Bandits (first seen 2025-12-09, last seen 2025-12-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Skirmishers and support troops armed with crossbows and scimitars
Faction: Hobgoblin forces
Location: Hobgoblin Cavern
- (2025-12-09) Bandits fought alongside the hobgoblins in waves against the party.

chunks.title: Hobgoblin Devastator
chunks.text:
NPC: Hobgoblin Devastator (first seen 2025-12-09, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Hobgoblin combat mage
Role: Enemy spellcaster in robes of office carrying an iron staff
Faction: Hobgoblin forces
Location: Hobgoblin Cavern
Status: alive
- (2025-12-09) He is a calm, precise combatant who can unleash powerful fireballs before retreating from the front line.
- (2025-12-09) He joined the fray alongside the hulking dragonborn and the Shadow Master.
- (2025-12-23) The Devastator stabilized the unconscious Mangler on his second attempt.
- (2026-01-06) The party recalled the Devastator as a combat mage specializing in explosive magic such as fireball and lightning bolt.

chunks.title: Hulking Dragonborn
chunks.text:
NPC: Hulking Dragonborn (first seen 2025-12-09, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: High-ranking enemy leader
Faction: Hobgoblin forces
Location: Hobgoblin Cavern
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-12-09) An enormous dragonborn with multicolored chromatic scales, a great axe crackling with necrotic energy, and a necrotic breath weapon.
- (2025-12-09) His soul-rending axe felled K'hakkik, who was revived by Patch.
- (2025-12-09) He captured the Mangler's unconscious body and dragged him deeper into the enemy's lair.
- (2025-12-23) The hulking dragonborn guarded the caged Mangler alongside the Shadow Master.
- (2025-12-23) The Mangler perceived the dragonborn as a true believer in some likely religious cause.

chunks.title: Hobgoblin Captain
chunks.text:
NPC: Hobgoblin Captain (first seen 2025-12-09, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Hobgoblin commander directing the battle tactically
Faction: Hobgoblin forces
Location: Hobgoblin Cavern
- (2025-12-09) He called out openings and granted his allies advantages in the fight.
- (2025-12-23) The Captain ordered torches and candles brought to burn away the webs, then marched out to join the pursuit.
- (2026-01-06) The Hobgoblin Captain was not significantly injured in the earlier fight and was present at the Mangler's pledge.

chunks.title: Sheriff Rixon
chunks.text:
NPC: Sheriff Rixon (first seen 2025-12-23, last seen 2026-02-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Harrowfield Sheriff
Role: Local sheriff who held the prisoners
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Cooperative
Status: alive
- (2025-12-23) Rixon assembled a posse and set up a checkpoint on the road into Harrowfield on Mynah's warning.
- (2025-12-23) Rixon deputized Mynah to inspect the cart's cargo.
- (2025-12-23) Rixon agreed to help the party create a fake shipment for the rescue plan.
- (2025-12-23) Rixon carries a prized smoke powder pistol that he displays to show authority.
- (2026-01-06) The Sheriff was reluctant to release the recovered stolen loot.
- (2026-01-22) Fezzle explained the egg smuggling to the sheriff, who deputized the party and gave them bronze dragon head badges.
- (2026-01-22) The sheriff agreed to gather a posse to watch for brigands.
- (2026-02-17) The sheriff sold the party 12 pairs of manacles for 24 gold.
- (2026-02-17) The sheriff received Mynah's note to deliver to his family.

chunks.title: Kaeless
chunks.text:
NPC: Kaeless (first seen 2025-12-23, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Local healer
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Cooperative
Status: alive
- (2025-12-23) Mynah asked Kaeless to gather anyone with martial or magical capability to help; she agreed but had limited resources.

chunks.title: Grix
chunks.text:
NPC: Grix (first seen 2025-12-23, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Kobold smuggler driving the contraband cart
Faction: Shadow Master's smuggling operation
Status: dead
- (2025-12-23) Grix, a kobold with an Obsidius city accent, drove the cart carrying the crate marked 'textile' for Varkenhold.
- (2025-12-23) Mynah identified Grix to Sheriff Rixon as their target, and the posse stopped him at the checkpoint.
- (2025-12-23) K'hakkik and Patch noticed Grix cast no shadow.
- (2025-12-23) In jail Grix said he was smuggling for money, to be paid at Varkenhold by someone who knew him by name; the party sensed he withheld information out of fear.
- (2025-12-23) When Grix mentioned the cave, he turned into a living shadow and tried to escape through the window.
- (2025-12-23) Patch's Turn Undead dissipated the shadow completely, and Grix showed a look of gratitude before fading.

chunks.title: Field Rats Urchin
chunks.text:
NPC: Field Rats Urchin (first seen 2025-12-23, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Urchin
Role: Young member of the field rats, a kobold youth gang
Location: Harrowfield
- (2025-12-23) Mynah, once a field rat herself, paid the urchin two silver pieces to carry a message to Sister Gladys at Heartland Station.

chunks.title: Jailer
chunks.text:
NPC: Jailer (first seen 2025-12-23, last seen 2025-12-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Jailer holding Grix
Location: Harrowfield
- (2025-12-23) The jailer was present when Grix dissolved; Mynah quipped he now had no extra mouth to feed.

chunks.title: Dinoshobu
chunks.text:
NPC: Dinoshobu (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Half-dragon cultist, lieutenant to Gidrog, wearer of purple
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Location: The Cave
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-01-06) Dinoshobu attempted to recruit the Mangler as a smuggler and proposed taking his shadow as leverage.
- (2026-01-06) When the Mangler resisted, Dinoshobu proposed an oath to Tiamat instead.
- (2026-01-06) Dinoshobu intoned the pledge to the Dread Mother during the Mangler's ritual.
- (2026-01-06) The Mangler learned Dinoshobu serves as Gidrog's lieutenant.

chunks.title: Gidrog
chunks.text:
NPC: Gidrog (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-02-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Gidrog the Chromatic Dragonborn, Gidrogg
Role: Chromatic dragonborn, Selvara's direct superior in the cult
