Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Location: The Cave
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-01-06) The Mangler learned Gidrog commands the operation.
- (2026-01-06) Gidrog was present at the Mangler's pledge to Tiamat.
- (2026-02-17) Nimbrax learned from Selvara's mind that Selvara worked for Gidrogg, who answered to Agonrain.

chunks.title: Marshal Jorovok
chunks.text:
NPC: Marshal Jorovok (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-02-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Joravak, Grand Marshal Joravak
Role: Commander of the hobgoblin forces in the field
Faction: Cult of the Dragon (hired hobgoblins)
Status: alive
- (2026-01-06) The Mangler overheard that Jorovok leads the hobgoblin forces in the field.
- (2026-02-17) Nimbrax learned Joravak leads the Starfang Horde of off-world hobgoblin mercenaries, about 600 at its core and possibly double with local recruits.

chunks.title: Tiamat
chunks.text:
NPC: Tiamat (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Deity worshipped by the Cult of the Dragon
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
- (2026-01-06) Her presence was felt at the ritual and she was the source of the binding charm placed on the Mangler.
- (2026-01-06) The Mangler glimpsed five pairs of eyes watching from the shadows above during the ritual.
- (2026-01-06) The binding also affected all wearers of purple.

chunks.title: Dwarven Woman
chunks.text:
NPC: Dwarven Woman (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: dwarven contact
Role: Cult of the Dragon contact in Varkenhold
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Location: Varkenhold
Status: alive
- (2026-01-06) She met the Mangler at the rail station, quietly named Dinoshobu and Gidrog, and told him to go to the Angry Owl.
- (2026-01-06) She was surprised when the Mangler tried to wheel the crate through the tavern door and sent him around the back.
- (2026-01-06) She opened the crate with a crowbar and inspected it against a mental checklist.
- (2026-01-06) She told him his payment was waiting at the train station.
- (2026-01-06) She mentioned answering to someone named Keorgan.

chunks.title: Keorgan
chunks.text:
NPC: Keorgan (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Superior of the dwarven contact
- (2026-01-06) The dwarven woman mentioned she answers to Keorgan.

chunks.title: Black Dragonborn Woman
chunks.text:
NPC: Black Dragonborn Woman (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: cloaked black dragonborn
Role: Important cultist riding inside the armored coach
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
Status: alive
- (2026-01-06) The party scried her in a meditative state in purple robes wearing a Spy's Murmur device.

chunks.title: Armored Coach Guards
chunks.text:
NPC: Armored Coach Guards (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-01-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Armed and Armored Humanoids
Role: Six guards, including a dragonborn, escorting the coach
Faction: Cult of the Dragon
- (2026-01-06) They loaded the crate with carrying poles and took crossbow positions on the coach roof.
- (2026-01-06) They dismissed a party member who asked if they were hiring.

chunks.title: Adult Black Dragon
chunks.text:
NPC: Adult Black Dragon (first seen 2026-01-06, last seen 2026-02-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Black Dragon (Lake)
Role: Recipient of the stolen treasure
Location: Lake outside Varkenhold
Status: alive
- (2026-01-06) The dragon rose from a mountain lake to meet the coach carrying the stolen goods.
- (2026-01-22) The black dragon emerged from the lake, gently took the delivered crate in its jaws and submerged again.
- (2026-01-22) The party noted it was smaller and more youthful than the ancient black wyrm they had met before.
- (2026-02-17) Tarrow and Selvara's absorbed memories identified the lake dragon as the mother of the eggs and local head of the cult.

chunks.title: Agonrain
chunks.text:
NPC: Agonrain (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: master, queen of all, master, queen of all
Role: Adult black dragon living in an underwater lair in a northern mountain lake
Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Location: Lake near the northern tunnel by Varkenhold
- (2026-01-22) A tattooed dwarf guard at the Berkenholt cargo yard bore Draconic script praising Tiamat and naming Agonrain as master.
- (2026-01-22) The party does not yet know who Agonrain is or how Agonrain connects to the black dragon at the lake.
- (2026-02-17) Agonrain was named as the adult black dragon in the lake outside Varkenhold who provides the eggs.
- (2026-02-17) Agonrain hunts alone at night in the mountains and receives sacrifices from the cult.
- (2026-06-09) Library research named the black dragon of the northern lake as Agonrain, son of the ancient Maulvrath the Ebon Queen.
- (2026-06-09) Agonrain's underwater lair is said to be inhabited by his living breath, a creature born of his exhalation that prowls the depths.
- (2026-06-23) Fezzle watched Agonrain erupt from the lake at dusk and devour body-sized bundles left by cultists.
- (2026-06-23) The cult feeds Agonrain on a regular schedule and he is suspected of providing scales for drake creation.

chunks.title: Tattooed Warriors
chunks.text:
NPC: Tattooed Warriors (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-02-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: tattooed guards
Role: Guards escorting the dragon egg crates
Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Location: Harrowfield Train Station
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: Captured; handed to Spotless
- (2026-01-22) The guards included a dwarf, a Goliath and humans, with Draconic tattoos praising Tiamat and Agonrain.
- (2026-01-22) They fought fiercely with little regard for their own safety.
- (2026-01-22) K'hakkik and Fezzle subdued them with non-lethal force and the party captured multiple cultists.
- (2026-02-17) Tarrow named the four tattooed warriors as Dren, Mari, Corin and Silas.
- (2026-02-17) The party handed the four tattooed warriors to Spotless.

chunks.title: Noble Overseer
chunks.text:
NPC: Noble Overseer (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Noble
Role: Robed noble overseeing the unloading of crates
Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Location: Harrowfield Train Station
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-01-22) The noble shouted a draconic curse at Patch that dealt thunder damage.
- (2026-01-22) Mynah struck the noble down with a chromatic orb.

chunks.title: Purple Tiefling
chunks.text:
NPC: Purple Tiefling (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Wearer of Purple
Role: Spellcaster leader meeting the egg shipment
Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive, captured
- (2026-01-22) She arrived at Harrowfield station with a Goliath and a human to meet the shipment.
- (2026-01-22) She attacked Patch with acid.
- (2026-01-22) The Mangler countered her attempt to cast Cure Wounds on her allies.
- (2026-01-22) The Mangler battered her with a flurry of attacks and the party subdued her.

chunks.title: Cultist Archer
chunks.text:
NPC: Cultist Archer (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-02-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Archer
Role: Elven hired archer for the cult
Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Fatalistic but forthcoming
Status: Captured; handed to Spotless
- (2026-01-22) The archer traded shots with Patch across the burning platform.
- (2026-01-22) The archer tried to flee when the purple tiefling fell, and Mynah ensnared her with a web.
- (2026-02-17) The archer is named Tarrow and has worked for the cult for sixty years.
- (2026-02-17) Tarrow said Selvara gave all orders and had Rail Guild contacts.
- (2026-02-17) Tarrow revealed the Drake Hatchery near Varkenhold and the Shadow Depot in the interior.
- (2026-02-17) Tarrow tried to slip her manacles during questioning; the Mangler noticed, tightened them and gagged her.

chunks.title: Baby Drakes
chunks.text:
NPC: Baby Drakes (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: newly hatched drakes
Role: Hatchlings from the smuggled eggs
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: two captured alive
- (2026-01-22) Two eggs hatched from the heat of Patch's wall of fire into wingless black drakes resembling guard drakes.
- (2026-01-22) The drakes attacked nearby combatants indiscriminately, including K'hakkik and The Mangler.
- (2026-01-22) The party captured two baby drakes alive.

chunks.title: Armored Coach Driver
chunks.text:
NPC: Armored Coach Driver (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Driver of the armored coach at Harrowfield station
Location: Harrowfield
- (2026-01-22) The Mangler hired the driver and sent him on a decoy errand to the crossroads with gibberish instructions and 120 gold.
- (2026-01-22) This removed the coach as a getaway option for the smugglers.

chunks.title: Tix
chunks.text:
NPC: Tix (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Young kobold paladin and responsible older sister of Mynah
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Protective
- (2026-02-03) Tix tried to keep the group out of trouble and doubted Fezzle's motives for returning to town, but his conviction persuaded her he had seen something.
- (2026-02-03) Tix suggested touring the pump house to distract the children from well-diving.
- (2026-02-03) Tix made Mynah promise never to reveal the night's events until he was older and part of a trusted adventuring party.

chunks.title: Zillik
chunks.text:
NPC: Zillik (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Street-smart local kid who plays loud instruments and casts minor illusion and message
Location: Harrowfield
- (2026-02-03) Zillik told ghost stories about Myanthoriax and used illusions and whispered messages, posing as her voice, to urge Mynah to find the ghost egg.
- (2026-02-03) Zillik conjured an illusory giant carrot that made the pump house mules run wild and drained the well quickly.
- (2026-02-03) Zillik deflected a guild inspector by calling the cargo both junk and fine boots, convincing him it was beneath guild concern.
- (2026-02-03) Zillik created a fire-screaming sound and played a loud horn as distractions in the cargo yard.
- (2026-02-03) Zillik and Rooch saw Grizzle receive a single black coin from Reda.

chunks.title: Rooch
chunks.text:
NPC: Rooch (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Young goblin friend of Fezzle; observant helper
Attitude to party: Friendly
- (2026-02-03) Rooch held Mynah's rope as he descended into the Dragon Well.
- (2026-02-03) Rooch's tremendous sneeze distracted an inspector at the critical moment in the cargo yard.

chunks.title: Myanthoriax
chunks.text:
NPC: Myanthoriax (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-05-12) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Spirit of Myanthoriax
Role: Ancient bronze dragon spirit, Mynah's ancestor
Status: Departed; her ghost appeared
Attitude to party: Friendly
- (2026-02-03) Myanthoriax's ghost swooped into the Dragon Well, carried Rooch and Mynah to the top, and looked at Mynah as if in recognition before flying toward the dimmed sun.
- (2026-02-03) An enormous bronze statue of Myanthoriax overlooks the Dragon Well.
- (2026-05-12) The Spirit of Myanthoriax possessed Mynah's body to protect the party while their spirits were in the astral plane.
- (2026-05-12) In Mynah's body the dragon spirit plucked The Mangler from a pool of slime and healed the dying Fezzle.
- (2026-05-12) The dragon spirit blasted a group of enemies back with a gust of wind and fought with claws and thunderous roars.
- (2026-05-12) The dragon spirit tore Master Horgath to pieces.

chunks.title: Watermaster Zeke
chunks.text:
NPC: Watermaster Zeke (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Zeke
Role: Kobold operator of the Dragon Well pump house
Location: Harrowfield
Attitude to party: Friendly
- (2026-02-03) Zeke gave the children a tour of the pump house and, persuaded by Mynah, agreed to demonstrate draining the well.
- (2026-02-03) Zeke insisted the night's events stay secret, calling it a completely normal night of operations.

chunks.title: Uncle Grizzle
chunks.text:
NPC: Uncle Grizzle (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Grizzle
Role: Secret worshiper of Maglubiyet
Faction: Formerly Farmers Guild
Status: alive
- (2026-02-03) Grizzle enlisted Fezzle and friends to ship potatoes disguised as boots, tools and parts, paying extra for secrecy.
- (2026-02-03) Grizzle received a single black coin from Reda after the shipment was loaded.
- (2026-02-03) Guild inspectors removed the guild sign from Grizzle's farm gate, stripping his membership.
- (2026-02-03) Grizzle vanished when a barn collapsed and six inspectors died.
- (2026-06-23) Fezzle's restored memory showed Grizzle donning a golden mask of Maglubiyet to summon two four-armed demons that killed Farmer's Guild inspectors in a barn.
- (2026-06-23) Grizzle walked unharmed through the burning barn and vanished into the night.
- (2026-06-23) Grizzle is a goblin priest of Maglubiyet who is still alive and free.

chunks.title: Saja
chunks.text:
NPC: Saja (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Heavily tattooed dwarf topsider contact with black dragon imagery on her arms
Location: Harrowfield Cargo Yard
- (2026-02-03) Saja and Reda received Grizzle's shipment and prepared for a fight with the inspectors before standing down.

chunks.title: Reda
chunks.text:
NPC: Reda (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Topsider contact in soft clothes who received Grizzle's cargo
Location: Harrowfield Cargo Yard
- (2026-02-03) Reda met Grizzle discreetly on the street and gave him a single black coin.

chunks.title: Farmers' Guild Inspectors
chunks.text:
NPC: Farmers' Guild Inspectors (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Guild Inspectors
Role: Armed officials with pistols and rapiers who enforce quotas and inspect shipments
Faction: Farmers Guild
Attitude to party: Suspicious
Status: Six killed in the barn collapse
- (2026-02-03) Inspectors followed Grizzle's wagon but were convinced the cargo was junk.
- (2026-02-03) Six inspectors were found dead in the collapsed barn with fire, slashing and dismemberment wounds.
- (2026-06-23) In Fezzle's restored memory, Farmer's Guild inspectors accused Grizzle of selling off the books and violating embargo before demons killed them.

chunks.title: Glump
chunks.text:
NPC: Glump (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Grizzle's slow, obedient mule
- (2026-02-03) Glump pulled Grizzle's wagon at a leisurely pace to Harrowfield.

chunks.title: Train Conductor
chunks.text:
NPC: Train Conductor (first seen 2026-02-03, last seen 2026-02-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Rail Guild conductor who quietly spoke with Grizzle
Faction: Rail Guild
- (2026-02-03) The conductor was seen pocketing something, likely a bribe, after meeting Grizzle.

chunks.title: Selvara
chunks.text:
NPC: Selvara (first seen 2026-02-17, last seen 2026-02-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Human priestess of Tiamat and cult leader in purple robes
Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Status: Mind absorbed by Nimbrax; body zombie-like
- (2026-02-17) Selvara stayed eerily calm under interrogation and gave nothing away when Mynah tried to deceive her.
- (2026-02-17) Selvara declared the Age of Dragons was coming and everyone would choose a side.
- (2026-02-17) Selvara offered an exchange of guild infiltrator information for interior town defenses but doubted the party would accept.
- (2026-02-17) The party placed a headbag on Selvara and took her to Nimbrax, which absorbed her mind.

chunks.title: Isalia
chunks.text:
NPC: Isalia (first seen 2026-02-17, last seen 2026-10-27) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Isolde
Role: clerk at Haverford's Haversack
Faction: Merchants Guild
Location: Haverford's Haversack, Obsidius
Attitude to party: Friendly, business-minded
Status: alive
- (2026-02-17) Isalia had helped Mynah before and greeted the party warmly.
- (2026-02-17) Isalia paid the party 2,000 gold for the Merchants Guild infiltrator dead drop information and 2,000 gold for the military intelligence.
- (2026-02-17) Isalia offered a recovery fee of one-tenth of one percent of recovered goods, bonuses for verified results, and a 5 percent discount at Haverford's in Obsidius.
- (2026-02-17) Isalia revealed they were running a trap on the dead drop, with five poorly disguised undercover operatives.
- (2026-03-03) Isolde used a palm-sized device to close the front doors and position the iron golems when the situation escalated.
- (2026-03-03) Isolde commanded the golems to stand down after The Mangler attacked the noble.
- (2026-03-03) Isolde pointed her device at the quasit and declared it a criminal, so the iron golems apprehended it.
- (2026-03-03) Isolde thanked the party for not wrecking the shop and calmed the other customers.
- (2026-03-03) The party briefed Isolde after a long rest and told her to say the quasit had escaped.
- (2026-03-31) Isolde confirmed Lys Meerenfell was disproven and lives on the Rock of Bral while her sons run the business.
- (2026-03-31) Isolde said there is no bad blood between her business and the Meerenfells.

chunks.title: Isalia (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Isalia (first seen 2026-02-17, last seen 2026-10-27) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-10-27) Isalia sold the party magical items at Haverford's Haversack.
- (2026-10-27) Isalia dismissed the rumors of Columbria's Ring of Wishes.

chunks.title: Iron Golems
chunks.text:
NPC: Iron Golems (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-03-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Security automatons at the front doors of Haverford's Haversack
Faction: Haverford's Haversack
Location: Haverford's Haversack
Status: alive
- (2026-03-03) The iron golems sealed the front doors when the situation escalated.
- (2026-03-03) The iron golems were unaffected by Losander's flash pearl.
- (2026-03-03) The iron golems struck Losander twice as he tumbled between them.
- (2026-03-03) On Isolde's command the iron golems stood down, then one golem felled the quasit with a single non-lethal punch.

chunks.title: Undercover Operatives
chunks.text:
NPC: Undercover Operatives (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-03-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Operatives
Role: Five mercenary agents stationed to intercept the dead drop
Location: Haverford's Haversack
- (2026-03-03) The five operatives moved on the noblewoman and found she was an illusion.
- (2026-03-03) The operatives ineffectively chased the quasit and the cloaked noble through the store.

chunks.title: Quasit
chunks.text:
NPC: Quasit (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-03-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Harike's familiar
Role: Harike's familiar; small demon with a broken left horn
Faction: Dragon Cult
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dismissed by its master
- (2026-03-03) Mynah's magically enhanced sight spotted the invisible quasit snacking on stolen jerky atop a shelf.
- (2026-03-03) Mynah's web caught the quasit, which threatened him in Draconic and then tore free.
- (2026-03-03) The quasit repeatedly turned invisible again after Mynah stripped its invisibility, and its magic resistance made it hard to restrain.
- (2026-03-03) The quasit failed its first save against Fezzle's Pipes of Haunting and was frightened.
- (2026-03-03) The iron golems knocked the quasit unconscious.
- (2026-03-03) Nimbrax absorbed the quasit for several hours but its master dismissed it before the process finished.
- (2026-03-03) Nimbrax learned from the quasit that its master is Harike, a warlock whose patron is a five-headed dragon.

chunks.title: Harike
chunks.text:
NPC: Harike (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Tiefling warlock assassin
Faction: Dragon Cult
Location: Northern mountain stronghold near Varkenhold
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-03-03) Harike appeared in silks around a street corner and launched scorching rays at The Mangler.
- (2026-03-03) Harike teleported away with Losander, leaving only footprints that stopped mid-stride.
- (2026-03-03) Nimbrax learned she is a warlock whose patron is a five-headed dragon and an enforcer who makes examples of people.
- (2026-03-03) Kroald said Harike was an Arcanists Guild member convicted of murdering a colleague and sentenced to indentured servitude.
- (2026-03-03) Kroald said the Merchant Guild bought her contract outright for a substantial sum.
- (2026-03-31) K'hakkik learned from the Halls of Records that Harike was convicted of multiple homicides but received a lenient sentence of life servitude instead of execution.
- (2026-03-31) Her contract was first held by the city and then bought for 100,000 gold by Captain Marcus Ordo of the Fallen Moon.
- (2026-03-31) Kroald Fortas revealed the true buyer was Lys Meerenfell.
- (2026-03-31) Spotless confirmed Harike's growing power and suggested she made a pact with Tiamat.
- (2026-03-31) GMAssistant's note says Harike was disproven from the Arcanist Guild for murdering a colleague.
- (2026-05-12) Harike ambushed the party behind a door alongside Losander, the Dragon Speaker and a Dragon Chosen.

chunks.title: Harike (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Harike (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-12) Harike used a fire and radiant spell and a hypnotic light that incapacitated Mynah and the kobold prisoners.
- (2026-05-12) Harike escaped into a slime-filled corridor and teleported away.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik's Mirror of the Past showed Harike suffering brutal abuse in her youth and then killing those who had wronged her.
- (2026-06-09) The mirror showed Master Horgath dragging Harike from a battlefield into a wagon.
- (2026-06-23) Mynah's attempt to scry on Harike failed when the sensor flickered and collapsed, repelled by her resistance.
- (2026-06-23) Fezzle glimpsed red and black robes near the northern tunnel entrance, suggesting Harike has retreated to the stronghold.

chunks.title: Alpha-1-1
chunks.text:
NPC: Alpha-1-1 (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Captain Alpha-1-1
Role: Captain of the Axiomatic
Faction: Axiomatic crew
Status: alive; forcibly unhanded during the mutiny
- (2026-03-17) Alpha-1-1 ordered the watch unit to investigate the derelict Belledawn.
- (2026-03-17) Alpha-1-1 later replaced one of his hands with an adamantine prosthetic, claiming it was more efficient.
- (2026-03-17) Alpha-1-1 was forcibly unhanded in the mutiny and his cursed prosthetic was cast into the void.

chunks.title: 5-5-Zeta
chunks.text:
NPC: 5-5-Zeta (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Navigator of the Axiomatic
Faction: Axiomatic crew
- (2026-03-17) 5-5-Zeta altered course toward the derelict Belledawn on the captain's orders.
- (2026-03-17) 5-5-Zeta communicates almost entirely in astrophysics and complex math.

chunks.title: Kappa-6-3
chunks.text:
NPC: Kappa-6-3 (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Warden of the Axiomatic; takes tactical command in conflict
Faction: Axiomatic crew
- (2026-03-17) Kappa-6-3 was alerted to the threat before the party boarded the Belledawn.
- (2026-03-17) The party brought its fears about the prosthetic hands to Kappa-6-3, and the confrontation became a mutiny.

chunks.title: 8-Delta-2
chunks.text:
NPC: 8-Delta-2 (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Archivist of the Axiomatic
Faction: Axiomatic crew
- (2026-03-17) 8-Delta-2 interviewed every crew member daily.
- (2026-03-17) After the mutiny, 8-Delta-2 decided it was safer for Patch not to remember and had his memories suppressed.
- (2026-03-17) Patch was left on a small planetoid and waited 235 years until someone found him.

chunks.title: Iota-9-Delta
chunks.text:
NPC: Iota-9-Delta (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Chief Artificer of the Axiomatic
Faction: Axiomatic crew
Status: alive; forcibly unhanded during the mutiny
- (2026-03-17) Iota-9-Delta had quietly replaced a hand with an adamantine prosthetic in his workshop.
- (2026-03-17) Iota-9-Delta was forcibly unhanded in the mutiny and the prosthetic was cast into the void.

chunks.title: Anchus
chunks.text:
NPC: Anchus (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Quartermaster of the Belledawn, an astral elf
Status: dead
- (2026-03-17) Anchus was found hanging in the forehelm with a bladed adamantine claw in place of his left hand.
- (2026-03-17) Anchus tied the noose with one hand and took his own life to stop the claw from winning.
- (2026-03-17) The party concluded Anchus was the survivor who removed and disposed of the other hands.

chunks.title: Zaren
chunks.text:
NPC: Zaren (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Chronomancer aboard the Belledawn
Status: missing; not among the dead
- (2026-03-17) Zaren kept a laboratory and permanent ritual space in the cargo hold, powerful enough to affect the whole ship.
- (2026-03-17) Zaren's notes recorded the temporal transit, the two contacts and his recommendation of Solas 337 to the Aphelion.

chunks.title: The Aphelion
chunks.text:
NPC: The Aphelion (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Aphelion
Role: Entity or vessel met by the Belledawn during its temporal transit, seeking a new home
- (2026-03-17) Zaren recommended the asteroid Solas 337 to the Aphelion.

chunks.title: The Merchant
chunks.text:
NPC: The Merchant (first seen 2026-03-17, last seen 2026-03-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Mysterious merchant met in the past who sold the enchanted adamantine prosthetic hands
- (2026-03-17) The merchant sold prosthetic hands to Belledawn passengers and crew, who bought them voluntarily.

chunks.title: Karleen
chunks.text:
NPC: Karleen (first seen 2026-03-31, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Carlene
Role: Human clerk in the basement intake cellar of the Obsidius Halls of Records
Location: Obsidius Halls of Records
Attitude to party: Friendly toward K'hakkik
- (2026-03-31) Karleen helped K'hakkik navigate the Halls of Records to find Harike's contract.
- (2026-03-31) K'hakkik often brings Karleen a rare confection she enjoys.
- (2026-06-09) Carlene helped K'hakkik navigate the stacks after he gave her a box of fruit jellies from his foster parents' shop.

chunks.title: Marcus Ordo
chunks.text:
NPC: Marcus Ordo (first seen 2026-03-31, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Captain Marcus Ordo, Marcus Orgo
Role: Captain of the spelljamming ship the Fallen Moon, a hammerhead privateer
Location: Rock of Bral (home port)
- (2026-03-31) Marcus Ordo bought Harike's servitude contract from Obsidius for 100,000 gold.
- (2026-03-31) The party concluded Ordo was a cutout hiding the true buyer.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik's Mirror of the Past showed Marcus's past as a blur of spelljamming and carousing.

chunks.title: Hans Jexx
chunks.text:
NPC: Hans Jexx (first seen 2026-03-31, last seen 2026-03-31) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: the Skeleton Key
Role: Notoriously effective and expensive advocate in Obsidius
- (2026-03-31) Hans Jexx represented Harike at her murder trial and secured her an unusually light sentence.

chunks.title: Frederick Arcalion
chunks.text:
NPC: Frederick Arcalion (first seen 2026-03-31, last seen 2026-03-31) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Judge in Obsidius who presided over Harike's murder trial
- (2026-03-31) Arcalion is known as formidable rather than lenient, which made Harike's sentence suspicious.

chunks.title: Lys Meerenfell
chunks.text:
NPC: Lys Meerenfell (first seen 2026-03-31, last seen 2026-03-31) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Former owner of The Shining Lys boutiques; believed buyer of Harike's contract
Faction: Merchants Guild (disproven)
Location: Rock of Bral
Status: alive
- (2026-03-31) Kroald Fortas told the party Lys Meerenfell bought Harike's contract.
- (2026-03-31) Lys was disproven from the Merchants Guild for refusing to pay guild duties.
- (2026-03-31) Her sons run her boutiques and her family may be financing the Dragon Cult.

chunks.title: Flump Clerk
chunks.text:
NPC: Flump Clerk (first seen 2026-03-31, last seen 2026-03-31) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Telepathic flump clerk at the Port Authority
Attitude to party: Cheerful and helpful
- (2026-03-31) The Flump Clerk helped the party find the Fallen Moon's logbooks.

chunks.title: Tattooed Warrior
names: female dwarf warrior covered in draconic tattoos
chunks.text:
NPC: Tattooed Warrior (first seen 2026-04-14, last seen 2026-04-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: female dwarf warrior covered in draconic tattoos
Role: Guard of the sewer hideout wielding returning handaxes
Faction: Dragon Cult
Location: Cultist Sewers
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: One dead; another alive at session end
- (2026-04-14) A tattooed dwarf warrior fought beside two guard drakes behind the fortified door, throwing magically returning handaxes.
- (2026-04-14) K'hakkik killed the first tattooed warrior after a furious exchange of blows.
- (2026-04-14) A second tattooed warrior engaged the party in the sewer corridor and killed The Mangler's ape, Seven.
- (2026-04-28) The Mangler shoved a tattooed warrior into the sewage with his warhammer.
- (2026-04-28) A tattooed warrior hurled a returning hand axe at Fezzle, and another struck K'hakkik.
- (2026-04-28) The Dragon Chosen fought with suicidal bravery using dual short swords and hand axes, and more poured from nearby rooms.

chunks.title: Kobold Inventors
chunks.text:
NPC: Kobold Inventors (first seen 2026-04-14, last seen 2026-04-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Kobold Inventor
Role: Inventors building a mechanical-undead hybrid
Location: Kobold Workshop
Status: Both dead
- (2026-04-14) Two kobold inventors were modifying a kobold on a table and activated their creation when startled.
- (2026-04-14) The Mangler killed one inventor, who dropped a pot of green slime.
- (2026-04-14) The other inventor was killed by their own mech.

chunks.title: Kobold Mech
chunks.text:
NPC: Kobold Mech (first seen 2026-04-14, last seen 2026-05-12) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Kobold Mechs
Role: Experimental construct of kobold flesh, machinery and a zombie, armed with a drill and spear cannon
Location: Kobold Workshop
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: destroyed
- (2026-04-14) The mech attacked indiscriminately on activation, killing its remaining creator and splashing green slime that coated the ape.
- (2026-04-14) Patch turned the undead creature within the mech, making it flee in terror.
- (2026-04-28) Two helicopter-like kobold mechs flew in with drills to flank the party, and a zombie-like mech coated in green slime also fought.
- (2026-04-28) The mechs could launch explosive javelins.
- (2026-04-28) Mynah destroyed one mech with a chromatic projectile but was caught in the explosion.
- (2026-04-28) Patch turned the mechs, making them flee.
- (2026-05-12) Several kobold mechs flew with small helicopter blades and attacked with javelins.
- (2026-05-12) The party destroyed the mechs and they detonated on death, providing salvage for Fezzle.

chunks.title: Kobold Chefs
chunks.text:
NPC: Kobold Chefs (first seen 2026-04-14, last seen 2026-04-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Kobold Chef
Role: Kobolds in chef's aprons carrying cleavers
Location: Room off the Kobold Workshop
- (2026-04-14) The Mangler briefly encountered two kobold chefs in a room off the main workshop area.

chunks.title: Master Horgath
chunks.text:
NPC: Master Horgath (first seen 2026-04-14, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Cruel overlord associated with ritual and sacrifice
Location: Fortified Sewer Hideout
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-14) At session end approaching enemies named Master Horgath, saying he would want to destroy the party personally.
- (2026-04-28) Master Horgath arrived in person and used a conjured acid claw to pull The Mangler through the air and severely wound him.
- (2026-04-28) Patch banished Master Horgath to another plane of existence.
- (2026-05-12) Master Horgath returned from his banishment and was shocked by the dragon spirit's appearance.
- (2026-05-12) Horgath attacked the dragon spirit with acid magic and a three-headed flail but was torn to pieces by it.
- (2026-05-12) His helm and vicious flail were recovered from his body.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik's Mirror of the Past showed Horgath recruiting Harike from a battlefield.

chunks.title: Seven
chunks.text:
NPC: Seven (first seen 2026-04-14, last seen 2026-04-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Ape summoned by The Mangler from the Tan Bag of Tricks
Attitude to party: Friendly
Status: dead
- (2026-04-14) The Mangler summoned the ape from his Bag of Tricks and named it Seven.
- (2026-04-14) Seven attacked a kobold inventor and crept along the ceiling to join the corridor fight.
- (2026-04-14) A tattooed warrior cut down Seven.

chunks.title: Dragon Cultists
chunks.text:
NPC: Dragon Cultists (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-04-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Dragon Cultist
Role: Robed followers of the dragon cult who attacked in waves
Faction: Dragon Cult
Location: Cultist Sewers
Attitude to party: Hostile
- (2026-04-28) The cultists emerged in waves from side passages, including an armory.
- (2026-04-28) Mynah's fireballs incinerated large groups of cultists.

chunks.title: Dragon Speaker
chunks.text:
NPC: Dragon Speaker (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-05-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Winged, lightning-crackling commander of the cultists
Faction: Dragon Cult
Location: Cultist Sewers
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-28) The Dragon Speaker's thunderous shout blasted Fezzle back into the sewer.
- (2026-04-28) His second shout destroyed Fezzle's Fez and blasted K'hakkik, who absorbed some of the elemental energy.
- (2026-04-28) He also hurled lightning bolts.
- (2026-05-12) The Dragon Speaker fled the dragon spirit fight but joined Harike's ambush.
- (2026-05-12) He was caught in Mynah's web and Patch's sphere of silence and was killed by The Mangler.

chunks.title: Black Draconian
chunks.text:
NPC: Black Draconian (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-04-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Stealthy ambusher with a poisoned dagger
Faction: Dragon Cult
Location: Cultist Sewers
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-28) The Black Draconian rose from the sewer water and stabbed and poisoned Mynah.
- (2026-04-28) The Mangler slew the Black Draconian.

chunks.title: Hulking Draconian
chunks.text:
NPC: Hulking Draconian (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-05-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Trident-wielding draconian leader
Faction: Dragon Cult
Location: Cultist Sewers
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-28) The Hulking Draconian conjured a noxious green gas cloud, which Patch dispelled.
- (2026-04-28) Mynah's second fireball left it bloodied but standing.
- (2026-04-28) It turned invisible to escape combat but was grappled by The Mangler.
- (2026-05-12) The dragon's breath pushed the Hulking Draconian back and a thunderous blast later killed it.
- (2026-05-12) On death its flesh shriveled and its bones exploded.

chunks.title: Losander
chunks.text:
NPC: Losander (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-11-10)
Role: Disavowed Expeditors Guild operative and master of disguise
Location: Columbria
Attitude to party: grateful, allied
Status: alive, reinstated and cleared
Faction: Expediters Guild
- (2026-03-03) Losander disguised himself with an illusion as a tall, broad-shouldered noble and walked toward the doors.
- (2026-03-03) Losander threw a flash pearl, tumbled between the iron golems and took two blows from them while escaping.
- (2026-03-03) The Mangler hit Losander twice with his longsword outside, and K'hakkik's javelin of lightning missed him.
- (2026-03-03) Losander escaped by grabbing Harike's hand, and both teleported away.
- (2026-03-03) Spotless identified Losander as a cowardly Expediters Guild halfling who makes his own flash pearls and had stopped taking guild contracts.
- (2026-03-03) Spotless suspected Losander was after Haverford's supplier ledgers.
- (2026-03-03) Kroald confirmed Losander once tried to become proven with the Arcanists Guild before choosing the Expediters.
- (2026-03-31) The boutique clerk offered to arrange an introduction to Losander when Mynah presented a dragon coin.
- (2026-04-28) Losander appeared from the shadows and wounded Fezzle's Fez with a volley of daggers and a massive sneak attack, then vanished.
- (2026-04-28) He later threw a dagger at one of the fleeing mechs.
- (2026-05-12) Losander critically wounded Fezzle with a sneak attack and held him hostage, demanding the party back off.

chunks.title: Losander (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Losander (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-11-10)
- (2026-05-12) The Mangler dragged Fezzle to safety, so Losander lost his leverage and teleported away.
- (2026-06-09) Losander contacted Mynah by sending, claiming he was framed for the Bank of Obsidius gem heist and never received the money.
- (2026-06-09) Losander offered to sell out the dragon cult entirely in exchange for reinstatement to the Expeditors Guild.
- (2026-06-09) Mynah replied through Patch, who served as the magical relay.
- (2026-06-09) Losander directed the party to rent a crystal ball from Benevio the Seer and scry him at noon the next day.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik's Mirror of the Past showed Losander only in disguise, moving from shadow to shadow.
- (2026-06-09) The Hall of Records disproving file said Losander consistently claimed innocence but genuinely could not remember where he was that night.
- (2026-06-23) Mynah contacted Losander telepathically through the Orb of Knowing and found him disguised as a halfling on a Low Market street corner.
- (2026-06-23) Losander named his rival Melanie Schorl (Spotless) as his prime suspect, citing an old contract dispute where he underbid her.
- (2026-06-23) Losander theorized Spotless persuaded Cauley to rob his own bank so that Cauley got the money and Losander took the fall.
- (2026-06-23) Losander pointed the party to the gem cutter Teresa Vanek in the Undermarket.
- (2026-06-23) Losander suspects his memory of the night was deliberately erased.

chunks.title: Losander (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Losander (first seen 2026-03-03, last seen 2026-11-10)
- (2026-07-07) GMAssistant notes Losander holds knowledge of the dragon cult that the party hopes to obtain in exchange for clearing his name.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes declared Losander reinstated and cleared within the guild.
- (2026-10-13) Losander sent a magical message thanking the party and reporting he was scouting Columbria.
- (2026-10-13) Losander said the Cult of the Dragon plans to assault Columbria to seize a Ring of Wishes and claim a Dragon Mask.
- (2026-10-27) Losander, operating undercover, intercepted Fezzle in the Threshold Bazaar.
- (2026-10-27) Losander chastised Fezzle for speaking too loudly about the cult.
- (2026-10-27) Losander revealed at least three other cult spies had infiltrated Columbria, including a priest of Kelemvor.
- (2026-10-27) Losander pointed the party toward the Hollow Cell.
- (2026-11-10) Losander had pointed the party to the Hollow Cell as an abandoned monastery where a previous ring bearer met a mysterious end. He had not checked it out himself.

chunks.title: Cult Fanatic
chunks.text:
NPC: Cult Fanatic (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-04-28) [unconfirmed record]
Faction: Dragon Cult
Attitude to party: Hostile
- (2026-04-28) The Cult Fanatic arrived with reinforcements.
- (2026-04-28) The Cult Fanatic tried to use a command spell to make K'hakkik cower, but K'hakkik resisted.

chunks.title: Priestess of Tiamat
chunks.text:
NPC: Priestess of Tiamat (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-05-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: High-ranking priestess in chromatic scale armor
Faction: Cult of Tiamat
Location: Cultist Sewers
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-04-28) She cast a mass healing spell on her allies.
- (2026-04-28) She called down a column of divine fire that struck down Fezzle.
- (2026-05-12) The priestess cast necrotic magic against the dragon spirit.
- (2026-05-12) The dragon spirit knocked her unconscious and she then died in the explosion of a dying kobold mech.
- (2026-05-12) The party found a magical amulet on her body.

chunks.title: Fire Elemental
chunks.text:
NPC: Fire Elemental (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-05-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Summoned ally
Attitude to party: Friendly
- (2026-04-28) The Mangler summoned it by crushing a red corundum elemental gem.
- (2026-04-28) It burned enemies as it moved through their spaces and had a damaging fiery aura.
- (2026-05-12) The fire elemental incinerated a Dragon Chosen and later burned through the webs during the second ambush.
- (2026-05-12) It guided the party's exploration alongside The Mangler.

chunks.title: Bronze Dragon Spirit
chunks.text:
NPC: Bronze Dragon Spirit (first seen 2026-04-28, last seen 2026-04-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Divine spirit that manifested through Mynah
Attitude to party: Friendly
- (2026-04-28) It manifested through Mynah when he was badly wounded and repelled all enemies with a breath weapon.
- (2026-04-28) It warned the party of a greater danger and pulled their spirits from their bodies into the Astral Plane.

chunks.title: Dragon Chosen
chunks.text:
NPC: Dragon Chosen (first seen 2026-05-12, last seen 2026-05-12) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Formidable cultist warrior
Faction: Dragon Cult
Attitude to party: Hostile
- (2026-05-12) The Mangler's fire elemental incinerated one Dragon Chosen in the first fight.
- (2026-05-12) Another Dragon Chosen fought in the second ambush until Patch blasted its spirit from its body.

chunks.title: Scolario
chunks.text:
NPC: Scolario (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Servant and polite liaison of the vampire lord Mr. Rednight
Faction: Mr. Rednight's household
Attitude to party: Polite but warning
Status: alive
- (2026-05-26) Scolario knocked on the laboratory door sixty-one minutes into the party's rest.
- (2026-05-26) He told the party they could stay as guests only if they made a small blood donation or left before nightfall.
- (2026-05-26) Mynah assured him the party would be gone well within the hour.
- (2026-05-26) The Mangler offered Scolario his services as a mercenary and spelljammer pilot for Mr. Rednight.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik's Mirror of the Past showed Scolario's childhood in poverty followed by a life buried in books and libraries.

chunks.title: Lord Rednight
chunks.text:
NPC: Lord Rednight (first seen 2026-05-12, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Lord Redknight, Lord Red Knight, Red Knight, Mr. Rednight
Role: Vampire lord who owns the underground complex
Location: Underground complex beneath Obsidius
Status: alive
Attitude to party: Unknown
- (2026-05-12) Captive kobolds told the party the nearby area was the domain of the vampire Lord Red Knight.
- (2026-05-12) A cultist found dead with a torn throat and drained of blood suggested Red Knight feeds on the lair's inhabitants.
- (2026-05-12) The party chose to avoid him for now.
- (2026-05-26) Mr. Rednight demands a blood donation from those who stay past nightfall, communicated through his servant Scolario.
- (2026-05-26) The Mangler left word offering his mercenary services to Mr. Rednight.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik's Mirror of the Past showed Lord Redknight as a younger man dressed as a fighter under a bright sun and blue sky.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik concluded Redknight walked the world before the fragmentation, possibly in the age of the Obsidian Empire, since Obsidius has had no blue sky in living memory.

chunks.title: Sizzy
chunks.text:
NPC: Sizzy (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-05-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Kobold minion of Mynah, formerly part of the cult's workforce
Attitude to party: Friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-05-26) Sizzy gave local knowledge of the base layout, including the treasure room.

chunks.title: Red Zack
chunks.text:
NPC: Red Zack (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-05-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Kobold minion of Mynah, formerly part of the cult's workforce
Attitude to party: Friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-05-26) Red Zack warned the party about the acid trap just before it went off.
- (2026-05-26) Red Zack confirmed the kobolds were never trusted with the vault's password.

chunks.title: Slivey
chunks.text:
NPC: Slivey (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-05-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Kobold minion of Mynah, formerly part of the cult's workforce
Location: Throm's Anvil
Attitude to party: Friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-05-26) Slivey helped carry loot and was recruited to guard Mynah's bastion.

chunks.title: Clay Golem
chunks.text:
NPC: Clay Golem (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-05-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Guardian of the treasure vault
Faction: Dragon Cult
Location: Treasure Vault
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-05-26) The golem was sustained by the acid and green slime in its chamber.
- (2026-05-26) The golem struck Fezzle, sapping her capacity to heal.
- (2026-05-26) Fezzle's scimitar flash blinded the golem.
- (2026-05-26) K'hakkik restrained it with the Iron Bands of Bilarro and it failed to break free.
- (2026-05-26) The Mangler killed it with a flail blow after it went berserk.

chunks.title: Slime-Covered Guard Drakes
chunks.text:
NPC: Slime-Covered Guard Drakes (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-05-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Guardians of the hallway to the vault
Faction: Dragon Cult
Attitude to party: Hostile
- (2026-05-26) The drakes were coated in reactive green slime, immune to acid and splattering attackers with corrosive goo.
- (2026-05-26) Mynah's Scroll of Fireball severely burned the drakes.

chunks.title: Black Koleb
chunks.text:
NPC: Black Koleb (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-05-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Supreme general of the ancient Cult of the Dragon; Draconian
Status: historical; known from statue
- (2026-05-26) A statue of Black Koleb stood in the cult's dining hall.
- (2026-05-26) Patch recognized him as commander of Tiamat's dragon armies in the ancient Obsidian Empire.

chunks.title: Witch Queen Iggwilv
chunks.text:
NPC: Witch Queen Iggwilv (first seen 2026-05-26, last seen 2026-05-26) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Iggwilv
Role: Witch Queen; commissioned Moonstalker
- (2026-05-26) Moonstalker was forged by the Winter Fae court to fulfill a debt to Iggwilv and embody her curse on werewolves.

chunks.title: Froilan
chunks.text:
NPC: Froilan (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Researcher freed by the party who assists in the Bastion's library
Location: The Bastion library
Attitude to party: Cooperative
- (2026-06-09) Froilan provided intelligence on the Great Grove Below and its connection to Khyber and the Daelkyr's growing influence.
- (2026-06-09) Froilan warned the party that the journey to the Great Grove Below would be extremely dangerous.

chunks.title: Maulvrath the Ebon Queen
chunks.text:
NPC: Maulvrath the Ebon Queen (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Ancient black dragon, namesake of the Ebon Sea
Location: Said to reside in the Ebon Sea
- (2026-06-09) Library research identified Maulvrath as the mother of Agonrain.

chunks.title: Silver Eyes
chunks.text:
NPC: Silver Eyes (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Silvereyes
Role: enigmatic masked head of the Expeditors Guild
Faction: Expeditors Guild
Attitude to party: cooperative, wary
Status: alive
Location: King's Tomb
- (2026-06-09) Silver Eyes personally oversaw the investigation into Losander's alleged theft and refusal to pay guild fees.
- (2026-08-18) Silvereyes sent K'hakkik a note by a street urchin, marked with two silver dots shaped like eyes, urging the party to find who hired Kruug and promising a reward.
- (2026-08-18) K'hakkik's contacts reported Silvereyes was pleased Kruug was removed and may be reconsidering Losander's conviction.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes replied tersely to Patch's sending that they would fetch the report from Proof.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes sent Fezzle a note marked with two silver dots telling the party to send a sending.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes ordered the party to bring Caule and proof to the King's Tomb at the fourth bell after sunset the next night.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes questioned Aldrich coldly about mechanics only, confirmed the conspiracy, and declared Losander reinstated and cleared.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes offered a reward of two thousand gold or a future favor; Mynah took the gold and the others held favors in reserve.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes searched the room when the final twenty thousand gold came up but found nothing.
- (2026-10-13) Silver Eyes warned that moving against Spotless would make the party targets.

chunks.title: Aldrich Fenniworth Caule
chunks.text:
NPC: Aldrich Fenniworth Caule (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Fennyworth Cauley, Cauley, Aldrich Fennyworth Caule, Aldrich Caule
Role: disgraced bank manager
Location: body carried by the party to the ship
Status: alive, resurrected and under compulsion to testify
Attitude to party: compelled cooperation
- (2026-06-09) Caule was cleared after a rigorous interrogation: he was at home that evening, had no stolen gems and his spending had not changed.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik's Mirror of the Past showed Caule as a longtime bank fixture.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik observed Caule lunching three times a week at Astanzas.
- (2026-06-09) Caule recently set up a private office in the Byzant Warehouse Complex and hired an Expeditors Guild bodyguard a few months ago, around the time of the heist.
- (2026-06-09) Spotless considers Caule an idiot.
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin revealed Cauley visited her twice on the night of the robbery.
- (2026-06-23) On the first visit Cauley had her replace his memory of a troubling evening with a fabricated quiet night at home.
- (2026-06-23) Less than an hour later Cauley returned and had Phaelin erase the entire evening.
- (2026-06-23) GMAssistant describes Cauley as ambitious, greedy and a close friend of Chairman Sansbury.
- (2026-09-01) Petunia suspects Cauley was the true culprit of the bank heist.
- (2026-09-01) Cauley rented Storehouse 9 at triple the normal rate.
- (2026-09-29) The party found Caule's fresh corpse in the vault, stabbed through the heart with a longsword.

chunks.title: Aldrich Fenniworth Caule (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Aldrich Fenniworth Caule (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-09-29) The party debated raising him, noting it might undo the memory alterations that framed Losander.
- (2026-09-29) The party agreed to carry his body back to the ship.
- (2026-10-13) Patch resurrected Aldrich with Raise Dead after a strange agonizing delay, and he woke in manacles asking about his son Sonny.
- (2026-10-13) Aldrich said he had bribed the Toll Taker with gems for two years to protect Sonny's ghost; the Toll Taker then declared it would take Sonny anyway and killed Aldrich when he drew a weapon.
- (2026-10-13) Patch lifted the curse on Aldrich's memory and Mynah read his thoughts, finding a man consumed by grief.
- (2026-10-13) Under compulsion, Aldrich admitted Spotless proposed robbing his own bank and framing Losander, and that she took ten thousand gold as her cut.
- (2026-10-13) Patch bound Aldrich with a powerful compulsion to testify truthfully and see Losander exonerated.
- (2026-10-13) Fezzle disguised Aldrich so well that the party barely recognized him.
- (2026-10-13) Aldrich testified before Silver Eyes under zone of truth and mind reading, and honestly said the Toll Taker took the last twenty thousand because he did not know the party intercepted it.

chunks.title: Benevio the Seer
chunks.text:
NPC: Benevio the Seer (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Seer and keeper of the Orb of Knowing
Location: High Market
Attitude to party: Friendly
- (2026-06-09) Losander directed the party to rent Benevio's crystal ball to scry him.
- (2026-06-23) Benevio let the party use the Orb of Knowing for an hour for 500 gold.
- (2026-06-23) Benevio revealed Losander had been a frequent client in past years.
- (2026-06-23) Benevio asked the party to pass his regards to his old friend Phaelin, the Mind Carver.

chunks.title: Brix
chunks.text:
NPC: Brix (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Gnomish lift operator at the Bank of Obsidius
Location: Bank of Obsidius
- (2026-06-09) Brix ferried K'hakkik down to the first vault level and chatted cheerfully, which K'hakkik senses is a front.
- (2026-06-09) K'hakkik found Brix's name among the maintenance workers who saw the impersonator on sub-level three the night of the heist.

chunks.title: Fiona Garyun
chunks.text:
NPC: Fiona Garyun (first seen 2026-06-09, last seen 2026-06-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Bank clerk at the Bank of Obsidius
Location: Bank of Obsidius
- (2026-06-09) Fiona Garyun handled K'hakkik's new storage account and explained the tiers of subterranean security.

chunks.title: Phaelin
chunks.text:
NPC: Phaelin (first seen 2026-06-23, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: The Mind Carver
Role: Memory-working practitioner who diagnoses, restores, removes and fabricates memories
Location: The Healing Mind, High Market
Attitude to party: Cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin diagnosed Patch's memory loss as intentional and mechanical, caused by a removed memory crystal.
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin observed that precisely removed memories are usually taken by the person themselves.
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin agreed to see Mynah at once when Mynah named Fennyworth Cauley.
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin offered to undo her work on Cauley free of charge if he consents.
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin restored Fezzle's trauma-blocked memories of his uncle Grizzle.
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin can sense honesty and deception but not illusions or shapeshifting, so a disguised person could have fooled her.
- (2026-06-23) Phaelin draws on a patron's power and her own psionic ability and only works on willing subjects.

chunks.title: Elven Child
chunks.text:
NPC: Elven Child (first seen 2026-06-23, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Intake coordinator for Phaelin
Location: The Healing Mind
- (2026-06-23) The elven child greeted the party at the door of The Healing Mind and guided them through the manor.

chunks.title: Warforged Butler
chunks.text:
NPC: Warforged Butler (first seen 2026-06-23, last seen 2026-06-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Manages client flow in Phaelin's manor
Location: The Healing Mind
- (2026-06-23) The warforged butler relays messages between the child and the Mind Carver.

chunks.title: Teresa Vanek
chunks.text:
NPC: Teresa Vanek (first seen 2026-06-23, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Teresa Vanik, Tressa Vanek
Role: Gem cutter processing the stolen trade gems
Location: The Undermarket
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-06-23) Teresa Vanek confirmed she had worked for Losander over the years and agreed to help clear his name.
- (2026-06-23) The client who brought her the stolen gems was an unknown intermediary, likely a one-time disguise.
- (2026-06-23) She had already cut 80 percent of the gems and takes a 5 percent cut of everything she processes.
- (2026-06-23) She agreed to use a sending stone to tip off the party about the final drop-off.
- (2026-06-23) Later she reported through the sending stone that the final batch had arrived early and cutting had begun.
- (2026-07-07) Teresa Vanik told the party through the sending stones that the cut gems would be delivered to Jolly Jewels in Troll Foot Square.
- (2026-07-07) Teresa agreed to delay the real shipment by a day so the party could run a decoy drop.
- (2026-07-07) GMAssistant says Teresa is risking her professional reputation to help clear Losander's name.
- (2026-08-18) Tressa Vanek told the party a new exchange would take at least a week and would be in the Towers District, at a wizard's magical mansion accessible only with the caster's permission.
- (2026-09-01) Tressa Vanek messaged the party that the final gem delivery was in two days and that Farla had moved it to Scaled Square.
- (2026-09-01) Tressa Vanek agreed to let the party magically track the gems after the handoff.

chunks.title: Jilly Jolly
chunks.text:
NPC: Jilly Jolly (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-08-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Halfling shopkeeper running Jolly Jewels; facilitates anonymous drop-offs with passphrases
Location: Jolly Jewels, Troll Foot Square
Status: alive
- (2026-07-07) Jilly Jolly unknowingly accepted the party's decoy gem case from an autognome courier.
- (2026-07-07) Patch's celestial spider crawled unseen into Jilly's booth to watch.
- (2026-08-18) Jilly Jolly accepted the autognome courier's small flat box and tucked it behind her counter, staying calm when the pickup fell through.

chunks.title: Krug's Ravagers
chunks.text:
NPC: Krug's Ravagers (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-07-07) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Iron Bat mercenaries
Role: Elite mercenary squad of five or six hitters for brutal contracts such as caravan ambushes and extortion
Faction: Mercenaries led by Kruug
Location: Troll Foot Square
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-07-07) Fezzle identified the five watchers in Troll Foot Square as Krug's Ravagers.
- (2026-07-07) The Ravagers watched the decoy exchange but did not move.
- (2026-07-07) Mynah's mind probe showed the Ravagers were targeting a courier, not the gems.
- (2026-07-07) They carry iron bat buckles as identifying sigils.

chunks.title: Kruug
chunks.text:
NPC: Kruug (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Krug
Role: Blackguard leader of Krug's Ravagers
Faction: Krug's Ravagers
Location: Throm's Anvil
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, resurrected and imprisoned in Nimbrax
- (2026-07-07) Kruug wears plate armor carved with bat wings and symbols of the archdevil Graz'zt, carries a glaive and reeks of brimstone.
- (2026-07-07) Kruug kept a close watch on The Mangler throughout the second day.
- (2026-07-21) Kruug arrived on a flaming nightmare horse flying over the rooftops, carrying a glaive wreathed in black smoke.
- (2026-07-21) Kruug sent The Mangler crashing prone to the street with a single word of command.
- (2026-07-21) Kruug projected magical dread that paralyzed Mynah with fear, while K'hakkik and The Mangler resisted it.
- (2026-07-21) Kruug used a suggestion to convince The Mangler to guard a jewelry store across the city, and The Mangler flew off.
- (2026-07-21) Kruug's necrotic glaive struck K'hakkik down, and his aura gave nearby allies advantage.
- (2026-07-21) Patch's radiant blast brought Kruug crashing to the ground, and his nightmare vanished.
- (2026-08-18) The Mangler looted Kruug's body for a coin purse, an ornate earpiece, bat-engraved plate armor and the black glaive.
- (2026-08-18) Patch reanimated Kruug's corpse as a zombie to carry the gunslinger's body up the docking tower stairs and scoop the Scholar's remains into a barrel.

chunks.title: Kruug (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Kruug (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-08-18) Fezzle found that Kruug had met a disguised, unsavory figure at the Tombstone before the job, but the employer's identity stayed unknown.
- (2026-09-01) K'hakkik's mirror showed Kruug's past: kindness to an injured pup, a young orc boy straining at an immovable stone, lost wrestling matches, and a brutal rescue of the wereboar from a gibbet.
- (2026-09-01) A vision showed Kruug kneeling before the six-fingered Graz'zt, who burned a mark onto his forehead.
- (2026-09-01) The final vision showed Kruug sharpening his glaive and whispering an Infernal mantra at an inn before a hooded, smoky figure entered his room.
- (2026-09-01) Patch spoke with Kruug's spirit, which was hostile and recognized Patch as his killer.
- (2026-09-01) Kruug offered to help fight the dragon cult in exchange for resurrection but refused to reveal where his treasure was.
- (2026-09-01) Kruug suggested the Adventurers Guild might front the cost of his resurrection.
- (2026-10-13) Patch ended Krug's zombie state and resurrected him, immediately binding him in stone-shaped bonds and iron manacles.
- (2026-10-13) Krug returned furious and cursed the party but could not escape the restraints.
- (2026-10-13) Nimbrax absorbed Krug's memories over several days, leaving him passive and silent while the party took shifts watching him.
- (2026-10-13) Krug's memories showed Spotless hired him to intercept the trade gem shipment and kill everyone who touched it, which he agreed to do for free.

chunks.title: Kruug (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Kruug (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-10-13) Krug's memories revealed a secret vault at the Great Bank protected by a magical lock and the passphrase 'platinum', holding platinum bars and gems worth over twelve thousand gold.
- (2026-10-13) Krug's crew of Greylinks, Foolian and Noctara Slim were each bound to him by his violent acts on their behalf.
- (2026-10-13) The party decided to leave Krug imprisoned within Nimbrax for now.

chunks.title: The Hard Case
chunks.text:
NPC: The Hard Case (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-08-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: street fighter, gunslinger
Role: Gunslinger of Krug's Ravagers
Faction: Krug's Ravagers
Location: Troll Foot Square
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-07-07) The Hard Case told The Mangler to go away rudely when asked about the job.
- (2026-07-07) Patch read his lips murmuring "See if he's by himself."
- (2026-07-07) Mynah read his mind and found the face of a blonde, braided courier named Farla with bodyguards.
- (2026-07-21) The Hard Case charged into the fight from the market alley and gained steadier aim near Kruug.
- (2026-07-21) Mynah restrained the Hard Case in a web and K'hakkik carved into him with repeated strikes.
- (2026-07-21) Mynah brought the Hard Case down with an acid strike.
- (2026-08-18) The Mangler looted a fine pistol with forty reloads, a scimitar, studded leather armor, 12 gold and an ornate earpiece from the Hard Case.

chunks.title: The Brute
chunks.text:
NPC: The Brute (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Kruug's enforcer, the party's abduction target; revealed to be a wereboar
Faction: Krug's Ravagers
Location: Throm's Anvil, encased in stone in the forge helm chamber
Attitude to party: Captive, panicked
Status: alive, captive
- (2026-07-07) The Brute answered The Mangler's job inquiry only with a silent stare, chin resting on his sword pommel.
- (2026-07-07) The party plans to follow him out of the square at dusk and ambush him.
- (2026-07-21) Mynah charmed the Brute into viewing him as a trusted friend, though the Brute still insisted he had to meet Kruug.
- (2026-07-21) Mynah's polymorph turned the Brute into a frog for about three seconds before his lycanthropy reasserted and he became a wereboar, causing commoners to flee.
- (2026-07-21) K'hakkik bound the wereboar with the Iron Bands of Bilaro and Mynah froze him with a word of command.
- (2026-07-21) Mynah removed the spy's murmur from the Brute's ear, and the Brute protested, fearing Kruug's reaction.
- (2026-07-21) The Brute shifted into a small boar form but stayed held by the bands, and Patch conjured a zone of silence around him.
- (2026-07-21) The Brute ended the session bound, in pig form, wrapped in a tarp and hauled by Mynah toward the spelljamming docks.
- (2026-08-18) Mynah rolled the Iron Bands into Nimbrax's chamber and K'hakkik released them, turning the wereboar back into a man.
- (2026-08-18) Nimbrax stunned the Brute telepathically.

chunks.title: The Brute (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: The Brute (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-08-18) Patch shaped the chamber floor to encase the Brute in stone from the neck down, leaving his nose and mouth clear and his eyes covered.
- (2026-08-18) Nimbrax learned the Ravagers were hired to intercept the courier Farla for the package she was to pick up, and her survival was not a concern to them.
- (2026-08-18) Kruug dealt directly with the employer, so the Brute knew only a physical description of Farla and not who commissioned the job.
- (2026-09-01) Through Nimbrax, the party learned the Brute's mind had been absorbed and that his loyalty to Kruug stemmed from Kruug saving his life.
- (2026-09-01) GMAssistant notes his real name is Gundru, nicknamed Rooter, and that his mind is simple and he let Kruug do the thinking.

chunks.title: The Skulker
chunks.text:
NPC: The Skulker (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-07-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Female rooftop assassin of Krug's Ravagers
Faction: Krug's Ravagers
Location: Troll Foot Square
Status: alive, fled
Attitude to party: Hostile
- (2026-07-07) Patch spotted the Skulker hidden beneath a cart in a cobblestone-colored cloak.
- (2026-07-07) On the second day the Skulker could not be located.
- (2026-07-21) The Skulker rained poisoned throwing knives from the rooftops, knocking K'hakkik unconscious the first time.
- (2026-07-21) The Skulker failed to locate Patch when she tried to ambush him.
- (2026-07-21) The Skulker vanished into the city after Kruug and the Scholar fell.

chunks.title: The Forger
chunks.text:
NPC: The Forger (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-07-07) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Anonymous stationery seller fronting for document and seal forgery
Location: Troll Foot Square
- (2026-07-07) The Forger refuses to give his name, citing professional anonymity, and says his orc son sometimes minds the booth.

chunks.title: Farla
chunks.text:
NPC: Farla (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: professional courier
Faction: close to the Sansbury family
Attitude to party: cautious
Status: alive
- (2026-07-07) Mynah found Farla's image in the Hard Case's mind, showing the Ravagers were hunting a courier.
- (2026-08-18) K'hakkik used the Mirror of the Past to see Farla's life, including her mechanical left arm, her warforged companions and a gravestone bearing the name Sansbury.
- (2026-08-18) Farla arrived at Jolly Jewelers with two warforged bodyguards and spotted Mynah and The Mangler.
- (2026-08-18) Mynah read the surface of Farla's thoughts and found she was already planning an exit because the pickup was compromised.
- (2026-08-18) Mynah approached a warforged bodyguard openly and told it the party knew what Farla carried and believed she was being set up; Farla withdrew without the package.
- (2026-08-18) Farla replied by message that she would not meet until after the delivery, would verify the party's claims and would not return to this drop location.
- (2026-08-18) K'hakkik learned Farla was once engaged to Chairman Sansbury's son, who died of disease weeks before the wedding.
- (2026-08-18) Farla sponsored several warforged into the Mercenary Guild, and the forge masters gifted her a new arm after she lost hers.
- (2026-09-01) Farla became extremely cautious and changed the gem drop location to Scaled Square.
- (2026-09-01) Farla's bodyguards left Storehouse 9 in a carriage while the gems remained inside.

chunks.title: The Nightmare
chunks.text:
NPC: The Nightmare (first seen 2026-07-21, last seen 2026-07-21) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Kruug's nightmare horse, flaming nightmare
Role: Kruug's flaming flying horse mount
Faction: Krug's Ravagers
Status: vanished when Kruug fell
- (2026-07-21) The nightmare galloped through the air without wings, its hooves trailing fire.
- (2026-07-21) Mynah banished the nightmare to another plane, and it returned when she lost concentration.
- (2026-07-21) The nightmare vanished when Kruug was brought down.

chunks.title: Shu
chunks.text:
NPC: Shu (first seen 2026-08-18, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: cobbler and self-described grandmother of the Pennykeepers
Faction: Pennykeepers
Location: Low Market
Attitude to party: friendly, grateful
Status: alive
- (2026-08-18) Shu met Fezzle and thanked the party for ending Kruug's extortion of Low Market merchants.
- (2026-08-18) Shu offered the Pennykeepers' eyes and ears, promised to ask who Kruug met at the Tombstone, and offered their basements and stockrooms as safe houses.
- (2026-08-18) Shu invited the party to a crab feed on the South Beach in four days.
- (2026-09-01) The Pennykeepers hosted the crab feed on the southern shore.

chunks.title: Pennykeepers
chunks.text:
NPC: Pennykeepers (first seen 2026-08-18, last seen 2026-08-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: association of honest Low Market merchants
Location: Low Market
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: active
- (2026-08-18) The Pennykeepers were extorted by Kruug's crew and are grateful to the party.

chunks.title: Shakla Dhum
chunks.text:
NPC: Shakla Dhum (first seen 2026-08-18, last seen 2026-08-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elder dwarf of The Mangler's clan
Faction: Durazthrom clan
Location: Low Market, Adamant Arcana
Attitude to party: sympathetic to The Mangler
Status: alive
- (2026-08-18) Shakla Dhum saw The Mangler in the Low Market and secretly left him a note in Dwarvish requesting a meeting at Adamant Arcana.
- (2026-08-18) Shakla Dhum told The Mangler that Voslakk is forgiving exiles and calling them home, and that he is welcome to return.
- (2026-08-18) Shakla Dhum said the clan's asteroid Deep Crown is powered by Warpstone, causing madness and mutations.
- (2026-08-18) Shakla Dhum said Voslakk would meet The Mangler as a clan leader in his own right.

chunks.title: Voslakk
chunks.text:
NPC: Voslakk (first seen 2026-08-18, last seen 2026-08-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: clan leader of Durazthrom
Faction: Durazthrom clan
Location: Deep Crown
Status: alive
- (2026-08-18) Voslakk is paying off debts and forgiving exiles to bring dwarves back to Deep Crown.

chunks.title: Adamantine Golem
chunks.text:
NPC: Adamantine Golem (first seen 2026-08-18, last seen 2026-08-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: security construct and salesman
Location: Adamant Arcana
Status: active
- (2026-08-18) The fifteen-foot Adamantine Golem answers only with a canned pitch about its invulnerability and weaponry, warning against severely mocking the merchandise.
- (2026-08-18) Patch tried to interrogate the golem about its manufacture and got only the prepared speech.

chunks.title: Graz'zt
chunks.text:
NPC: Graz'zt (first seen 2026-09-01, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: the Shadow King, Prince of Pleasures, the Obsidian Man
Role: six-fingered demon lord who marked Kruug as a champion
Attitude to party: unknown; smiled at K'hakkik in a vision
- (2026-09-01) In a vision, Graz'zt appeared handsome, with piercing eyes, wreathed in shadow and purple flame.
- (2026-09-01) In the vision Graz'zt looked directly at K'hakkik and smiled.
- (2026-09-01) K'hakkik deciphered Kruug's Infernal mantra as a prayer to Graz'zt for victory in the Blood War and the end of the cycle of life.

chunks.title: Brega
chunks.text:
NPC: Brega (first seen 2026-09-01, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: middle-aged dwarven fishmonger and Pennykeepers leader
Faction: Pennykeepers
Location: stall in Scaled Square
Attitude to party: friendly, helpful
Status: alive
- (2026-09-01) Brega told the party of a sea serpent sighting, which the party realized was the ancient black dragon they had seen.
- (2026-09-01) Brega was given a Spy's Murmur and acted as lookout, alerting the party two days later when the courier made the drop.

chunks.title: Osric
chunks.text:
NPC: Osric (first seen 2026-09-01, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: gnome tinker who gathers gossip on house calls
Faction: Pennykeepers
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-09-01) Osric reported strange growling from cages inside Storehouse 9.

chunks.title: Petunia
chunks.text:
NPC: Petunia (first seen 2026-09-01, last seen 2026-09-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elderly human seamstress who passes secret messages sewn into clothing
Faction: Pennykeepers
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-09-01) Petunia revealed that Cauley rented Storehouse 9 at an exorbitant rate and sent her clothes heavy with saltwater damage despite living far from the water.
- (2026-09-01) Petunia recognized the description of Weaveless Cloth as a legendary material whose manufacture is debated by textile experts.

chunks.title: Sif
chunks.text:
NPC: Sif (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: The Rogue Assassin
Role: assassin hired by Greylinks
Attitude to party: cooperative after parley
Status: alive, released in Obsidius
Location: Obsidius skydocks crowd
- (2026-09-15) Sif unlatched a crocodile cage, and the released crocodile clamped onto K'hakkik's leg.
- (2026-09-15) Patch blasted Sif with a bolt of holy energy.
- (2026-09-15) Sif fired poisoned crossbow bolts at K'hakkik.
- (2026-09-15) Mynah's attempt to banish Sif into a pocket dimension failed, and she escaped into the crowded streets.
- (2026-09-29) Sith outran the air elemental through the city streets and ducked into a restaurant to hide.
- (2026-09-29) The air elemental struck Sith with thunderous blows, bloodying her, as she fled.
- (2026-09-29) Sith ambushed Fezzle from beneath a table in the restaurant with poisoned knives, leaving him bloodied and bleeding.
- (2026-09-29) Mynah turned Sith into a small turtle with his own magic, and her weapons and gear shrank with her.
- (2026-09-29) The transformation lasts only an hour, so Mynah must get her to Nimbrax before it ends.
- (2026-10-13) Syf (Sif) burst back into her true form with blades drawn when Mynah dropped his concentration on the polymorph.
- (2026-10-13) Patch's stone cage failed to catch Syf; she twisted out of the way.
- (2026-10-13) K'hakkik's grasping vines and roots seized Syf as she fled toward the hallway.
- (2026-10-13) Fezzle offered Syf a parley, answers in exchange for her life, and she agreed to talk.

chunks.title: Sif (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Sif (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-10-13) Syf said Greylinks hired her for one thousand gold to help steal a box.
- (2026-10-13) Mynah read the surface of her thoughts, confirmed she was truthful, and learned she and her crew planned to take extra from the banker's home.
- (2026-10-13) The party agreed that Syf is free and never takes a contract against them, and may serve as an informant.
- (2026-10-13) Syf made a mark on Patch's paperwork, Patch healed her, and Mynah staked her chips at the gambling hall, where she came out slightly ahead.
- (2026-10-13) The party released Syf near the Obsidius skydocks.

chunks.title: Greylinks
chunks.text:
NPC: Greylinks (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Expeditors Guild member and former member of Krug's crew
Faction: Expeditors Guild
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, fled
- (2026-09-15) The party recognized her distinctive crossbow bolt fletching from the earlier clash with Krug's Ravagers.
- (2026-09-15) The Mangler teleported to Greylinks and grappled her into the air, but she twisted free and shot him with a poisoned bolt.
- (2026-09-15) Greylinks fled with Myca across the rooftops and into the streets.
- (2026-10-13) Syf named Greylinks as the well-regarded Expeditors Guild member who hired her for a thousand gold.
- (2026-10-13) Krug's memories showed Krug murdered people who had wronged Greylinks, earning her devotion.

chunks.title: Tiff
chunks.text:
NPC: Tiff (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-15) [unconfirmed record]
Role: hidden archer ambushing from the roof
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, wounded, fled
- (2026-09-15) Tiff loosed a volley of arrows at Fezzle, most of which deflected off his magical shield.
- (2026-09-15) Fezzle's sweeping conjured blades wounded Tiff badly and sent her scrambling off the roof's edge.

chunks.title: Armored Guard
chunks.text:
NPC: Armored Guard (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-15) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: armored guard captain
Role: heavily armored leader of the warehouse security detail
Location: Storehouse Nine
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-09-15) The Armored Guard fought Mynah's spirit dragon with a longsword and struck the Fez.
- (2026-09-15) Mynah killed the Armored Guard with a burst of sorcerous energy.

chunks.title: Warehouse Guards
chunks.text:
NPC: Warehouse Guards (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-15) [unconfirmed record]
Role: mercenaries guarding Storehouse Nine
Location: Storehouse Nine
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-09-15) Several guards were choking in a toxic green cloud when the party arrived.
- (2026-09-15) Fezzle incinerated a guard who shouted a warning.
- (2026-09-15) The hidden assassin stabbed one of the guards with a short sword.
- (2026-09-15) Mynah's spirit dragon tore through one guard and breathed lightning across another.

chunks.title: Thug
chunks.text:
NPC: Thug (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Warehouse Thug
Role: warehouse enforcer wielding a warhammer
Location: Storehouse Nine
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-09-15) The Thug swung a warhammer at the party without landing anything of consequence.
- (2026-09-15) K'hakkik finished the Thug with a flurry of blade strikes.
- (2026-09-29) K'hakkik knocked the thug unconscious with the flat of his blade.
- (2026-09-29) Sonny's howl killed the unconscious thug.

chunks.title: Saltwater Crocodiles
chunks.text:
NPC: Saltwater Crocodiles (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-29) [unconfirmed record]
Role: giant captive reptiles; four caged on the western wall and two loose in the boat pen
Location: Storehouse 9 boat pen
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, freed into the bay
- (2026-09-15) One released crocodile clamped onto K'hakkik's leg until he terrified it into letting go.
- (2026-09-15) K'hakkik repeatedly scorched the caged crocodiles with his flaming boots, enraging them.
- (2026-09-15) The enraged crocodiles began smashing their iron cages.
- (2026-09-15) Patch conjured a wall of fire to contain them, and one that broke free was scorched.
- (2026-09-29) Two crocodiles tore free of their cages and slid into the tank water; the other four remained stranded in the mud once the tank drained.
- (2026-09-29) Patch dropped the wall of fire after the crocodiles could no longer climb out of the twenty-foot tank.
- (2026-09-29) Patch opened the valves to flood the bay so the crocodiles could swim free.

chunks.title: The Ghostly Toll Collector
chunks.text:
NPC: The Ghostly Toll Collector (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: imperial toll collector, The Toll Taker
