Role: ghostly rider serving the Lord Below, collecting tolls
Location: submerged iron door beneath Storehouse Nine's boat pen
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: undead, driven off
- (2026-09-15) The figure walked silently across the water, passed through the warehouse wall, and disappeared through a submerged rusty iron door.
- (2026-09-15) K'hakkik and The Mangler recognized the uniform as that of an imperial toll collector, said in legend to collect supernatural debts rather than coin.
- (2026-09-29) The toll taker rose from the sunken door dragging Sonny on a spectral chain, with the box of stolen gems in his satchel.
- (2026-09-29) He said he accepts bribes but gives nothing in return, and that the toll is always paid.
- (2026-09-29) Mynah's charm on the toll taker failed and the fight began.
- (2026-09-29) He summoned four ghostly sword wraiths when hurt and hurled spectral manacles at The Mangler, who kicked free.
- (2026-09-29) K'hakkik's psychic blow drove him off; he told K'hakkik, "You owe."
- (2026-10-13) Aldrich said the Toll Taker accepted his gem bribes for two years before claiming Sonny anyway and killing Aldrich.
- (2026-10-13) GMAssistant noted K'hakkik is now on the Toll Taker's list for having defeated it earlier.

chunks.title: Summoned Ape
chunks.text:
NPC: Summoned Ape (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-29) [unconfirmed record]
Role: creature summoned by The Mangler's Bag of Tricks
Location: loose in the warehouse district
Status: alive, loose in the city
- (2026-09-15) The ape climbed the crates to stay out of the fight.
- (2026-09-15) The tiger turned on it, and it fled the warehouse into the city.
- (2026-09-29) The ape bounded out the open door into the city and became a loud distraction, drawing every eye in the street.

chunks.title: Summoned Tiger
chunks.text:
NPC: Summoned Tiger (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Warehouse Tiger
Role: creature summoned by The Mangler's Bag of Tricks
Location: loose in the warehouse district
Status: dead
- (2026-09-15) Left without orders, the tiger turned on the summoned ape.
- (2026-09-29) K'hakkik clubbed the tiger unconscious with non-lethal blows.
- (2026-09-29) Sonny's howl killed the unconscious tiger.

chunks.title: Summoned Spirit Dragon
chunks.text:
NPC: Summoned Spirit Dragon (first seen 2026-09-15, last seen 2026-09-15) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: draconic spirit
Role: spirit summoned by Mynah
Faction: Mynah
- (2026-09-15) The spirit dragon tore through guards and fought the Armored Guard.
- (2026-09-15) Its lightning breath disrupted Myca's concentration and dissolved the toxic cloud.

chunks.title: Sonny Caule
chunks.text:
NPC: Sonny Caule (first seen 2026-09-29, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Sonny
Role: Aldrich's son
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: ghost hunted by the Toll Taker
- (2026-09-29) Sonny resembles the banker Aldrich Fennyworth Caule and wailed that it was all his fault for being greedy and disobedient.
- (2026-09-29) Sonny tried to bond with The Mangler's soul, but The Mangler slammed his mind shut.
- (2026-09-29) Sonny's grief howl killed the unconscious thug and tiger and left Fezzle shaking with fear.
- (2026-09-29) Patch turned Sonny and he fled, bloodied and howling.
- (2026-10-13) Aldrich said Sonny fell into debt with criminals and was murdered, and his ghost was hunted by the Toll Taker.

chunks.title: Sword Wraiths
chunks.text:
NPC: Sword Wraiths (first seen 2026-09-29, last seen 2026-09-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Sword Wraith Warriors
Role: ghostly warriors summoned by the toll taker
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: two destroyed, two fled
- (2026-09-29) Four sword wraiths with life-draining axes were summoned by the toll taker.
- (2026-09-29) A wraith's axe nearly drained K'hakkik's life but he shook it off.
- (2026-09-29) Patch turned the wraiths and they fled through the walls toward the sea; the air elemental and a radiant bolt destroyed two.

chunks.title: Foolian the Scholar
chunks.text:
NPC: Foolian the Scholar (first seen 2026-07-07, last seen 2026-10-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Foolian, The Scholar
Role: member of Krug's crew; former Arcanists Guild member
Faction: Krug's Ravagers
Location: Low Market streets, Obsidius
Attitude to party: Hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-07-07) The Scholar slipped into a pub at day's end and left by a different alley.
- (2026-07-21) The Scholar hurled acid and fireballs, and he cursed Mynah with a slow spell, halving her movement and making her magic unreliable.

- (2026-11-10) Matthias told Mynah he does not want to be near what may happen. He said visitors who ignore the warnings are not seen again, and that someone who does not go inside might live and be the first on the second column of his ledger.
- (2026-11-10) He refused to give Mynah details about the monastery, saying details only give adventurers false confidence and that faith is about the wisdom of not entering. He advised that anyone who must retrieve a friend should touch nothing, get the friend and leave.

chunks.title: Hollow Cell
chunks.text:
Location: Hollow Cell (first seen 2026-10-27, last seen 2026-11-10)
Also known as: the Hollow
Type: abandoned monastery
Parent: Columbria
Description: Closed monastery of the Hollow One (Hel), watched over by Brother Matthias; revealed to be a haunting revenant that animates the whole building
- (2026-10-27) Losander said a previous ring bearer met a mysterious end here.
- (2026-10-27) Patch's owl familiar spotted flickering candlelight and scattered bone fragments here.
- (2026-11-10) Hargan said something bad happened at the monastery decades ago involving outsiders, and nobody has come out since; the council keeps an old man posted out front to log who goes in and out.
- (2026-11-10) The monks of the monastery worshiped the Hollow One, an aspect of Hel, a contemplative sect focused on the emptiness of death.
- (2026-11-10) Secretary Brannick said the monastery is closed for everyone's safety after deaths several years ago, and that signs of activity inside are not believed to be the living.
- (2026-11-10) Patch's clairvoyance sensor in the lit cell showed a ruined 10 by 10 monk's cell: a smashed cot, burned chair and desk, a door off its hinges, a lantern hook worn from repeated use, a window broken inward, old bloodstains newer than the scorch marks, and two rafters stained with blood at one end.
- (2026-11-10) The walls are stone and the roof is tile on timber; most windows are shuttered, with chimneys all around and a chained front gate. Fezzle and K'hakkik failed Athletics checks to pry the shutters, which the GM ruled to be false.

chunks.title: Hollow Cell (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Hollow Cell (first seen 2026-10-27, last seen 2026-11-10)
- (2026-11-10) Mangler pried a shutter off in the courtyard with a 23 Athletics check, which triggered the building. All the shutters opened and it inhaled; Mangler failed a Charisma save and was pulled inside, and the window he entered by vanished into a blank wall.
- (2026-11-10) The building attacked with rafters (25 bludgeoning on Mangler), flying furniture, a stone slam for 28 bludgeoning, tiles that hit K'hakkik for 28, and a critical hit of 51 on the Fez. Its interior constantly shifts, with doors that rotate or seal and total cover for everything inside against attacks from outside.
- (2026-11-10) The building pulled K'hakkik and Fezzle inside with a Charisma save effect, while Patch resisted. Mynah's fireballs, K'hakkik's conjure barrage, Patch's wall of fire and chopping through a support timber brought it down, and the building collapsed.
- (2026-11-10) Inside swarmed dozens of undead Hollow Monks in monk garb, led by a robed Hollow Abbot. The Abbot cursed Mangler with a vow of revenge, and the monks grappled and suffocated Mangler and K'hakkik.
- (2026-11-10) The Abbot wore a ring, raised his hand, said 'I wish' and withered to dust. The Hollow Monks collapsed, and what he wished for is left for next session.
- (2026-11-10) Brother Matthias packed up his camp and walked toward town when the noise began, saying 'oh, I'm afraid it's too late now.'
